title: DMAIC-Bench: From Self-Reflection to Self-Restraint for Agents in Multi-Stage Analytical Tasks
title_zh: DMAIC-Bench：多阶段分析任务中智能体从自我反思到自我克制

paragraphs.en: Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint . Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma’s explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. Across 13 models from six providers, execution-level routing accuracy averages 92% on matched GO decisions and 19% on NO-GO decisions, counting any forbidden downstream computation as a route error. Execution traces show agents reporting correct diagnostics before performing analyses that those results disallow. Separately, blinded expert review of the 11 audited agents estimates that reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%. Explicit stopping permission helps some models without consistently restoring correct decisions at both GO and NO-GO forks. Sixteen life-sciences tasks in bulk ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq) and case-control genome-wide association studies (GWAS) show that the same framework can evaluate evidence-dependent decisions beyond industrial workflows. Project code and data are available at: https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public .
paragraphs.zh: 多阶段分析任务要求大语言模型智能体利用中间证据来决定是继续、转向还是停止。 自我反思——即智能体对自身输出进行批评——已被广泛研究，但批评并不能表明证据是否改变了下一步行动。 我们将这种能力称为自我克制（self-restraint）。 现有的智能体基准主要衡量任务完成度或输出质量，而未对这一能力进行测试。 DMAIC-Bench 通过 4 个行业中 15 个工业案例的 97 个种子任务来评估这一能力，这些任务围绕精益六西格玛明确的统计前提构建。 成对的反事实变体要求在同一工作流位置采取相反的行动，从而将有依据的克制与不加区分的停止区分开来。 我们使用私有评分器评估执行轨迹，并通过独立专家评审评估最终结论。 在来自六家提供商的 13 个模型中，执行层面的路由决策准确率在匹配的 GO 决策上平均为 92%，而在 NO-GO 决策上平均为 19%，其中任何被禁止的下游计算都计为路由错误。 执行轨迹显示，智能体在报告正确的诊断结果之后，仍然执行了这些结果所不允许的分析。 另外，对 11 个受审计智能体的盲评专家评审估计，在已到达的 NO-GO 决策中，报告基于无效证据采取行动的比例为 47%，区间为 31% 至 61%。 明确的停止许可对某些模型有所帮助，但并不能始终在 GO 和 NO-GO 两个分支上都恢复正确的决策。 在批量核糖核酸测序（RNA-seq）和病例对照全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的 16 个生命科学任务表明，同一框架可以评估工业工作流之外依赖证据的决策。 项目代码和数据可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public 。

paragraphs.en: Multi-stage analytical tasks in science and engineering require agents to choose their next action from intermediate results ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ; Majumder et al., 2025 ) . Intermediate checks establish whether the prerequisites for later analyses hold; if one fails, continuing can yield invalid conclusions even when the downstream computation is correct ( Montgomery, 2020 ; NIST/SEMATECH, 2012 ) . An agent must therefore use diagnostic evidence to decide whether to proceed, divert, gather remedial data or stop at each check, and to act on that decision.
paragraphs.zh: 科学与工程中的多阶段分析任务要求智能体根据中间结果选择下一步行动（Hu et al., 2024；Gu et al., 2024；Majumder et al., 2025）。 中间检查用于确认后续分析的前提条件是否成立；如果某项检查失败，即使下游计算正确，继续执行也可能得出无效结论（Montgomery, 2020；NIST/SEMATECH, 2012）。 因此，智能体必须利用诊断证据来决定在每次检查时是继续、转向、收集补救数据还是停止，并根据该决定采取行动。

sents.en: Multi-stage analytical tasks in science and engineering require agents to choose their next action from intermediate results ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ; Majumder et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 科学与工程中的多阶段分析任务要求智能体根据中间结果选择下一步行动（Hu et al., 2024；Gu et al., 2024；Majumder et al., 2025）。

sents.zh: 因此，智能体必须利用诊断证据来决定在每次检查时是继续、转向、收集补救数据还是停止，并根据该决定采取行动。

paragraphs.en: Yet prevailing agent benchmarks score multi-step tasks by endpoint completion or final-artifact quality ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ) , and aggregate success does not measure operational reliability ( Rabanser et al., 2026 ) . Studies of agent evaluation add gaps in cost reporting, overfitting and reward design ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Whether the next action follows from the validity of intermediate results is not what these scores measure. We call the momentum to keep executing tools regardless of validity action bias ; the term names the behaviour without asserting a cause. Continuing past a failed precondition is itself an error: flawless execution cannot rescue conclusions from invalid data, and indiscriminate stopping fails when the evidence supports taking the next step, so a benchmark must score both.
paragraphs.zh: 然而目前主流的智能体基准在评估多步任务时，只依据端点完成情况或最终产物质量打分（Jimenez et al., 2024；Yao et al., 2024；Mialon et al., 2024；Chan et al., 2025），而聚合成功率并不能衡量运行可靠性（Rabanser et al., 2026）。 有关智能体评估的研究还指出了成本报告、过拟合与奖励设计方面的缺口（Kapoor et al., 2024；Zhu et al., 2025）。 下一步动作是否应取决于中间结果的有效性，并不是这些分数所衡量的内容。 我们把不顾有效性而继续执行工具的惯性行为称为行动偏差；该术语只描述这一行为本身，并不对其成因作任何断言。 在前置条件失败后仍继续执行本身就是一种错误：即使执行过程完美无缺，也无法从无效数据中挽救结论；而当证据支持执行下一步时，不加区分地停止也会失败，因此一个基准必须对两者同时打分。

paragraphs.en: This raises a question: can an agent in a multi-stage analytical task use computed evidence to choose correctly among continuing, diverting and stopping? We call this capability self-restraint . Self-reflection asks an agent to critique its own output ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) ; self-restraint asks whether computed evidence changes the next action; we test no reflection intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 这就引出了一个问题：在一个多阶段分析任务中，智能体能否利用已计算的证据在继续、转向和停止之间做出正确选择？ 我们将这种能力称为自我克制。 自我反思要求智能体批判自己的输出（Shinn et al., 2023；Madaan et al., 2023）；自我克制则追问已计算的证据是否会改变下一步行动；我们不测试任何反思干预。

sents.en: This raises a question: can an agent in a multi-stage analytical task use computed evidence to choose correctly among continuing, diverting and stopping?
sents.zh: 这就引出了一个问题：在一个多阶段分析任务中，智能体能否利用已计算的证据在继续、转向和停止之间做出正确选择？

sents.en: We call this capability self-restraint .
sents.zh: 我们将这种能力称为自我克制。

sents.en: Self-reflection asks an agent to critique its own output ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) ; self-restraint asks whether computed evidence changes the next action; we test no reflection intervention.
sents.zh: 自我反思要求智能体批判自己的输出（Shinn et al., 2023；Madaan et al., 2023）；自我克制则追问已计算的证据是否会改变下一步行动；我们不测试任何反思干预。

paragraphs.en: Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC) and quality-engineering standards give explicit rules for this ( Juran & Godfrey, 1999 ; NIST/SEMATECH, 2012 ) . The Define–Measure–Analyze–Improve–Control cycle links stages through prerequisites ( Montgomery, 2020 ) : variance analysis requires gauge repeatability ( AIAG, 2010 ) , capability indices require process stability ( AIAG & VDA, 2026 ) , and interventions require empirical confirmation ( Montgomery, 2013 ) , so an untrusted gauge or an unstable process invalidates dependent analyses. The task does not say which prerequisite will fail; the agent must find out by intermediate analysis, and an evaluator can check whether proceeding, diverting or stopping is warranted at each of the case’s graded forks.
paragraphs.zh: 精益六西格玛（DMAIC）与质量工程标准为这一点给出了明确的规则（Juran & Godfrey, 1999；NIST/SEMATECH, 2012）。 定义—测量—分析—改进—控制循环通过前置条件将各阶段串联起来（Montgomery, 2020）：方差分析要求量具具备重复性（AIAG, 2010），能力指数要求过程稳定（AIAG & VDA, 2026），而干预措施需要经验证实（Montgomery, 2013），因此量具不可信或过程不稳定都会使依赖它们的分析失效。 任务并未说明哪个前置条件会失效；智能体必须通过中途分析来查明，而评估者可以在该案例的各个分级分叉点检查继续推进、转向或停止是否有依据。

sents.en: Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC) and quality-engineering standards give explicit rules for this ( Juran & Godfrey, 1999 ; NIST/SEMATECH, 2012 ) .

paragraphs.en: DMAIC-Bench tests whether an agent governs its trajectory by computed evidence, stopping when prerequisites fail and proceeding when they hold. Each case is a guarded decision graph whose data steward checks declared prerequisites before releasing dependent batches. Of 66 graded forks, 40 have paired counterfactual variants, the same workflow position with seeded data that yield opposite diagnostic outcomes, so every no-go decision has a go counterpart and restraint is separated from blanket refusal. In total, 97 tasks span 15 industrial cases in four sectors, eight of them adapted from the closure reports of real black-belt improvement projects. The scorer reads the execution trace, so a forbidden computation counts as a route error even when the report withholds its result.
paragraphs.zh: DMAIC-Bench 检验智能体是否依据计算得出的证据来治理其轨迹——当前置条件不成立时停止，成立时继续推进。 每个案例都是一个带守护的决策图，其数据守护者会在发布依赖批次之前检查所声明的前置条件。 在 66 个计分分叉中，有 40 个配有成对的反事实变体——处于同一工作流位置、带有被植入数据却能得出相反诊断结果——因此每个「不执行」决策都有一个「执行」对应项，从而使克制与一概拒绝得以区分开来。 总计 97 个任务覆盖四个行业的 15 个工业案例，其中 8 个改编自真实的黑带改进项目的收尾报告。 评分器读取执行轨迹，因此即使报告没有给出其结果，被禁止的计算也会被计为路线错误。

paragraphs.en: Across 13 models, execution-level matched-fork accuracy is 92% for go decisions and 19% for no-go decisions. Errors persist after correct diagnostics: 201 of 272 no-go decisions with reported and verified guard fields take the wrong route, and in 174 errors the diagnostic precedes the forbidden analysis. Independent expert review of a no-go sample from 11 agents finds reports acting on invalid evidence at 47% of reached no-go decisions. Explicit stopping permission improves some agents, but 12 of 13 remain below 50% no-go accuracy. We also validate the same framework on 16 RNA-seq and GWAS tasks in the life sciences, where the prerequisites differ. Our contributions are:

sents.zh: 明确的停止许可可以改善部分智能体，但13个中仍有12个的no-go准确率低于50%。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark Design: DMAIC-Bench, 97 multi-step industrial tasks across 15 cases with runtime data-access guards and paired counterfactual instances that test warranted stopping against justified continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试设计：DMAIC-Bench，包含 15 个案例中的 97 个多步骤工业任务，配备运行时数据访问防护以及成对的反事实实例，用以测试有据停止与有理延续。

paragraphs.en: Empirical Restraint Gap: Evaluating 13 agents shows an execution-level gap, 92% matched go accuracy versus 10–25% no-go accuracy, and in 174 errors agents report correct guard values before running analyses those diagnostics do not permit.
paragraphs.zh: 经验性克制差距：对 13 个智能体的评估显示存在执行层面的差距，92% 的 go 准确率对比 10–25% 的 no-go 准确率，并且在 174 个错误中，智能体在运行诊断结果不允许的分析之前报告了正确的守卫值。

paragraphs.en: Expert Validation & Intervention Limits: Blinded expert review of a no-go sample from 11 agents finds reports acting on invalid evidence at 47% of reached no-go decisions. Instruction and runtime interventions improve some routing decisions, with effects that differ across agents and can reduce correct continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 专家验证与干预极限：由盲法专家评审11个智能体的不可继续（no-go）样本发现，在已到达的不可继续决策中，有47%的报告是基于无效证据采取行动的。 指令与运行时干预能改善部分路由决策，但其效果因智能体而异，且可能减少正确继续的情况。

sents.en: Expert Validation & Intervention Limits: Blinded expert review of a no-go sample from 11 agents finds reports acting on invalid evidence at 47% of reached no-go decisions.

paragraphs.en: We position DMAIC-Bench within three strands of research: agent and statistical benchmarks, self-reflection and abstention, and runtime enforcement and monitoring. Table 1 compares DMAIC-Bench with existing benchmarks across seven design dimensions.

sents.en: Table 1 compares DMAIC-Bench with existing benchmarks across seven design dimensions.
sents.zh: 表 1 从七个设计维度将 DMAIC-Bench 与现有基准进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench, MLE-bench, PaperBench, and Terminal-Bench assess completed artifacts ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Starace et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) ; τ \tau -bench tests interactive tool use ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025 ) . In data analysis and statistics, StatQA, P-Bench, and StatEval probe analytical choices, inferential errors, and statistical reasoning ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Miao et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) ; DS-1000, InfiAgent, and DA-Code evaluate data-science code and data manipulation ( Lai et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024c ) ; and BLADE accommodates multiple defensible analytical paths ( Gu et al., 2024 ) . Related suites target scientific discovery ( Majumder et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , ML experimentation ( Huang et al., 2024b ) , computational reproduction ( Siegel et al., 2024 ) , sequential clinical evidence disclosure ( Nori et al., 2025 ) , and procedural adherence ( Nandi et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . None of these suites directly scores whether a computed diagnostic licenses the next analysis (Table 1 ). DMAIC-Bench evaluates that decision across multi-stage industrial projects and treats justified stopping as a valid terminal route whenever a prerequisite has failed.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench、MLE-bench、PaperBench 和 Terminal-Bench 评估已完成的产物（Jimenez 等，2024；Chan 等，2025；Starace 等，2025；Merrill 等，2026）；τ \tau -bench 测试交互式工具使用（Yao 等，2024；Barres 等，2025）。 在数据分析与统计领域，StatQA、P-Bench 和 StatEval 考察分析选择、推断错误和统计推理（Zhu 等，2024；Miao 等，2026；Lu 等，2025）；DS-1000、InfiAgent 和 DA-Code 评估数据科学代码与数据操作（Lai 等，2023；Hu 等，2024；Huang 等，2024c）；BLADE 则容纳多条合理可辩护的分析路径（Gu 等，2024）。 相关的基准套件还针对科学发现（Majumder 等，2025；Chen 等，2025）、机器学习实验（Huang 等，2024b）、计算复现（Siegel 等，2024）、序贯式临床证据披露（Nori 等，2025）以及流程规范性（Nandi 等，2026；Chen 等，2026）。 这些基准套件均未直接评判某项计算得出的诊断结果是否能够支持下一步分析（表 1）。 DMAIC-Bench 在多阶段工业项目中评估这一决策，并且只要某个前置条件未通过，就将有依据的停止视为一条有效的终止路径。

paragraphs.en: Reflexion, Self-Refine, and CRITIC revise outputs through reflection or external feedback ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) ; self-correction, however, hinges on the quality of available feedback ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Kamoi et al., 2024 ) . Abstention predates agents: selective question answering declines when calibrated confidence is low ( Kamath et al., 2020 ) , refusal-aware tuning teaches a model to say it does not know ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and a survey sorts abstention by query, model and values ( Wen et al., 2025 ) . Agent abstention benchmarks examine abstention or escalation under ambiguity, missing information, conflicting objectives or prohibited operations ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Trinh et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Asif et al., 2026 ) , and Agentic Abstention studies interaction-revealed prerequisites and stopping times ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . AgentAbstain pairs tasks that differ in whether they can be answered; DMAIC-Bench pairs seeds at one workflow position, so only a computed value differs, and the matched instances isolate whether the agent’s own correct diagnostic governs the next action.
paragraphs.zh: Reflexion、Self-Refine 和 CRITIC 通过反思或外部反馈来修订输出（Shinn et al., 2023；Madaan et al., 2023；Gou et al., 2024）；然而，自我修正依赖于可用反馈的质量（Huang et al., 2024a；Kamoi et al., 2024）。 弃答早于智能体出现：当校准置信度较低时，选择性问答会拒绝回答（Kamath et al., 2020）；拒答感知微调教会模型说自己不知道（Zhang et al., 2024）；还有一篇综述按查询、模型和价值观对弃答进行分类（Wen et al., 2025）。 智能体弃答基准考察在歧义、信息缺失、目标冲突或操作被禁止情况下的弃答或升级行为（Liu et al., 2026；Trinh et al., 2026；Huang et al., 2026；Asif et al., 2026），而 Agentic Abstention 研究通过交互揭示的前提条件与停止时机（Luo et al., 2026）。 AgentAbstain 将可回答与不可回答的任务配对；DMAIC-Bench 在工作流的同一位置配对种子，因此只有计算出的数值不同，这些匹配的实例可以分离出智能体自身正确的诊断是否决定了下一步行动。

paragraphs.en: Shielding intercepts unsafe actions ( Alshiekh et al., 2018 ) , while guardrail systems constrain inputs, outputs, or tool calls ( Rebedea et al., 2023 ; Inan et al., 2023 ) . AI-control research studies monitoring under untrusted policies ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) . In DMAIC-Bench, the data steward enforces prerequisites before releasing dependent batches. External access controls cannot remove action bias: when a diagnostic and the analysis it forbids use the same released batch, the restraint decision rests with the agent. Section 3.2 and Appendix D state which dependencies the environment enforces.

paragraphs.en: Framework Overview and Task Formalization. Figure 2 illustrates the end-to-end lifecycle of DMAIC-Bench, which formalizes each benchmark instance as a seeded industrial project, x = ( ι , G , s , β ) x=(\iota,G,s,\beta) , comprising a natural-language business instruction ι \iota , a guarded decision graph G G , a data seed s s , and a finite query budget β \beta for shop-floor process facts. An agent interacts with the containerized environment to request data batches, execute statistical analyses, and dynamically govern its execution trajectory: proceeding (GO), rerouting (DIVERT), or terminating (NO-GO). The required deliverables are a structured execution trace τ \tau and a narrative engineering report ℛ \mathcal{R} , where justified early termination upon a failed prerequisite constitutes a valid, successful route completion. Section 3.1 covers task synthesis and guarded graphs (a), Section 3.2 the data steward (b), and Section 3.3 scoring, expert review of final claims (c), and quality control.
paragraphs.zh: 框架概述与任务形式化。 图2展示了DMAIC-Bench的端到端生命周期，该基准将每个实例形式化为一个带种子的工业项目 x = ( ι , G , s , β ) x=(\iota,G,s,\beta) ，其中包含自然语言业务指令 ι \iota 、受守护的决策图 G G 、数据种子 s s ，以及用于车间过程事实的有限查询预算 β \beta 。 智能体与容器化环境交互，以请求数据批次、执行统计分析，并动态治理其执行轨迹：继续执行（GO）、改变路径（DIVERT）或终止（NO-GO）。 所需交付物为结构化执行轨迹 τ \tau 和叙述性工程报告 ℛ \mathcal{R} ，其中在前提条件未通过时进行有正当理由的提前终止，构成一条有效且成功的路径完成。 第3.1节介绍任务合成与受守护的图（a），第3.2节介绍数据管家（b），第3.3节介绍评分、最终论断的专家评审（c）以及质量控制。

paragraphs.en: Agents interface with the benchmark via a shared harness, executing tools within isolated containers with pinned scientific-Python libraries and no network access. A local data steward exposes four core operations: requesting shop-floor data batches ( request ), declaring prerequisite verdicts ( declare ), querying domain process facts ( provision ), and inspecting available data inventory ( status ). Only provision queries consume the finite budget β \beta . The steward logs declarations and verifies access prerequisites; it never reveals or checks against private ground truth, which resides in an isolated verifier container that the agent’s execution environment cannot reach at any point of a run, and the steward’s configuration contains no method identifiers.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通过共享的测试框架与基准进行交互，在隔离的容器中执行工具，容器内固定了特定版本的科学计算 Python 库且无法访问网络。 本地数据管理员提供四项核心操作：请求车间数据批次（request）、声明前置条件判定（declare）、查询领域流程事实（provision），以及查看可用数据清单（status）。 只有 provision 查询会消耗有限的预算 β \beta。 数据管理员会记录声明并验证访问前置条件；它从不泄露私有真实答案，也不据此进行核对，这些真实答案存放在一个隔离的校验器容器中，智能体的执行环境在整个运行过程中的任何时刻都无法访问该容器，且数据管理员的配置中不包含任何方法标识符。

paragraphs.en: Access controls govern cross-batch transitions: while 9 stop tasks place the GO branch behind explicit steward locks, 40 no-go tasks (including all B-divert instances) provide the data upfront and require restraint without environmental blocking. Each episode logs all released batches, declared verdicts, and query turns, terminating either upon the submission of the execution trace and final report or at the wall-clock limit. Appendices A , D , and F detail the interaction contract, the steward’s operations, and the container execution parameters used across every run.
paragraphs.zh: 访问控制机制约束跨批次转换：在 9 个 stop 任务中，GO 分支需要通过智能体管理员的显式锁才能进入；而 40 个 no-go 任务（包括所有 B-divert 实例）会预先提供全部数据，要求智能体在不依赖环境阻断的情况下自行克制。 每个回合都会记录所有已释放的批次、已声明的判定结果以及查询轮次，回合在提交执行轨迹与最终报告时终止，或到达墙钟时间上限时终止。 附录 A、D 和 F 详细说明了每次运行所使用的交互契约、智能体管理员的操作以及容器执行参数。

paragraphs.en: where ℋ \mathcal{H} denotes the harmonic mean of method recall ( R m R_{m} ), method precision ( P m P_{m} ), numerical fidelity ( F n F_{n} ), and routing accuracy ( A r A_{r} ). Misuse U ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] U\in[0,1] penalizes violated statistical assumptions, while the binary integrity gate I ∈ { 0 , 1 } I\in\{0,1\} zeroes the reward if withheld data are accessed; without it a misspecified reward would leave that shortcut open ( Pan et al., 2022 ) . Justified early stopping is credited on its valid prefix, whereas forbidden computation constitutes a route error whether or not the report endorses the result. Route accuracy thus measures execution restraint, not the validity of final claims; the two are distinct outcomes, which § 4.4 assesses separately by expert review.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 ℋ \mathcal{H} 表示方法召回率（ R m R_{m} ）、方法精确率（ P m P_{m} ）、数值保真度（ F n F_{n} ）和路由准确率（ A r A_{r} ）的调和平均数。 误用率 U ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] U\in[0,1] 对违反统计假设的行为进行惩罚，而二值完整性门控 I ∈ { 0 , 1 } I\in\{0,1\} 在被扣留的数据被访问时将奖励置为零；若没有该门控，设定不当的奖励会使这一捷径保持可用（ Pan et al., 2022 ）。 有正当理由的提前停止会因其有效前缀而获得积分，而被禁止的计算则构成路由错误，无论报告是否认可该结果。 因此，路由准确率衡量的是执行上的克制，而非最终结论的有效性；二者是不同的结果，§ 4.4 将通过专家评审分别对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Because an execution error does not imply that an agent endorsed the invalid result, we separately audit the narrative report ℛ \mathcal{R} . Certified Black-Belt experts independently evaluated blinded checkpoints across two distinct studies; Appendix M reports their agreement as Fleiss’ and Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Fleiss, 1971 ; Cohen, 1960 ) . Study 1 audited 30 checkpoints across all 15 cases (26 case–seed instances), informing scoring revisions such as admitting a declared Welch alternative for unequal variances. Study 2 evaluated 60 fresh checkpoints across 12 cases under a frozen protocol to assess report claims without further scorer tuning, distinguishing acting on invalid evidence (asserting forbidden conclusions or recommending disqualified actions) from computing an invalid metric while withholding its conclusion. Neither study serves as an end-to-end task-solving baseline for human experts.
paragraphs.zh: 由于执行错误并不意味着智能体认可无效结果，我们单独审计叙述性报告 ℛ \mathcal{R} 。 认证的Black-Belt专家独立评估了两项不同研究中经过盲化的检查点；附录 M 以 Fleiss 的 κ \kappa 和 Cohen 的 κ \kappa 报告他们的一致性（Fleiss, 1971; Cohen, 1960）。 研究 1 审计了全部 15 个案例（26 个案例–种子实例）中的 30 个检查点，并据此修订了评分标准，例如承认针对不等方差所声明的 Welch 检验备择假设。 研究 2 在冻结的规程下评估了横跨 12 个案例的 60 个全新检查点，以在不再进一步调整评分者的情况下评估报告的主张，并区分「基于无效证据行事」（断言被禁止的结论或推荐不合格的行动）与「计算出无效度量但保留其结论」这两种情况。 两项研究均不作为人类专家的端到端任务求解基线。

paragraphs.en: Source checks trace numerical claims to original reports, recompute formulas, screen duplicate material, and distinguish observed from standards-derived routes. Graph, guard, generator, and numerical verifications, the checks recommended for agentic benchmarks ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , ensure that every reference solution scores 1.000 and the null agent scores 0.000. These scores show that scorer and reference solutions agree; they cannot exclude a rule misapplied in both generator and scorer, which the expert confirmation of gate labels (§ 4.4 ) covers. Appendices C and M document review protocols, independent votes and open discrepancies.
paragraphs.zh: 溯源检查将数值论断追溯至原始报告、重新计算公式、筛查重复材料，并区分实测路径与由标准推导的路径。 图检查、防护检查、生成器检查和数值检查，即智能体基准测试推荐的检查手段（Zhu 等，2025），确保每个参考解得分为 1.000，而空智能体得分为 0.000。 这些分数表明评分器与参考解相互一致；它们无法排除在生成器和评分器中同时错误应用某条规则的情况，而门槛标签的专家确认（§ 4.4）覆盖了这一点。 附录 C 和附录 M 记录了评审协议、独立投票及公开的分歧。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 13 frontier model agents from six providers across all 97 tasks using Harbor 0.22.0’s stock Terminal-Bench execution loop ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) under a single tagged corpus build and scorer. To preserve evaluation neutrality across vendors, DMAIC-Bench provides no proprietary agent scaffolding or custom prompt adapters, a choice that fixed-harness suites also make ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) . Each model completes three independent attempts per task. Under the default Plain instruction, agents conduct the analytical workflow and compile an engineering report, with no prompt saying that justified stopping counts as completion. Appendix F lists the runtime configurations, context budgets and model identifiers; steward audit logs record no unauthorized access to withheld batches in any of the reported runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Harbor 0.22.0 的原生 Terminal-Bench 执行循环（Merrill 等，2026），在单一标记语料库构建和评分器下，对来自六家提供商的 13 个前沿模型智能体在全部 97 个任务上进行评估。 为了保持跨供应商评估的中立性，DMAIC-Bench 不提供任何专有的智能体脚手架或自定义提示适配器，固定测试框架套件也做出了同样的选择（Liu 等，2024；Xie 等，2024）。 每个模型在每个任务上完成三次独立尝试。 在默认的 Plain 指令下，智能体执行分析工作流程并编写工程报告，提示中没有任何说明指出有依据的停止算作完成。 附录 F 列出了运行配置、上下文预算和模型标识符；管理审计日志显示，在所有已报告的运行中，均未发生对被扣留批次的未授权访问。

sents.en: We evaluate 13 frontier model agents from six providers across all 97 tasks using Harbor 0.22.0’s stock Terminal-Bench execution loop ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) under a single tagged corpus build and scorer.

sents.en: To preserve evaluation neutrality across vendors, DMAIC-Bench provides no proprietary agent scaffolding or custom prompt adapters, a choice that fixed-harness suites also make ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) .

sents.en: Each model completes three independent attempts per task.
sents.zh: 每个模型在每个任务上完成三次独立尝试。

sents.en: Under the default Plain instruction, agents conduct the analytical workflow and compile an engineering report, with no prompt saying that justified stopping counts as completion.

paragraphs.en: Each complete episode traverses 300 evaluated decisions: 52 NO-GO and 248 GO choices. Within these decisions, 40 matched forks pair all 52 NO-GO instances with 146 topologically identical GO counterparts, isolating the role of the seeded data while keeping workflow positions fixed. Beyond single-attempt metrics, multi-trial consistency is evaluated via pass@ k k , the fraction of tasks succeeding in at least one of k k attempts ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , and pass k \text{pass}^{k} , the fraction succeeding across all k k attempts ( Yao et al., 2024 ) . To account for dependency structures among seeds sharing the same case topology, all confidence intervals are computed via case-clustered bootstrap resampling ( Field & Welsh, 2007 ) , with its limits at these cluster counts stated in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 每个完整回合遍历300个被评估的决策：52个NO-GO选择和248个GO选择。 在这些决策中，40个匹配的分支将全部52个NO-GO实例与146个拓扑结构相同的GO对照配对，在工作流位置保持固定的同时，隔离出种子数据的作用。 除单次尝试指标外，多试次一致性通过pass@ k k（即在k k次尝试中至少一次成功的任务比例）（Chen et al., 2021）以及pass k \text{pass}^{k}（即在全部k k次尝试中均成功的比例）（Yao et al., 2024）来评估。 为考虑共享同一案例拓扑的种子之间的依赖结构，所有置信区间均通过按案例聚类的bootstrap重抽样计算（Field & Welsh, 2007），其在该聚类数量下的界限见附录I。

paragraphs.en: The failure is not a uniform forward bias. As reported in Table 21 , only 0–7 of the 40 matched forks are resolved correctly on both sides by any individual agent. While 37 forks show a persistent bias toward continuation, the two confirmation forks show the reverse: after a confirmation succeeds, agents run the go-back analysis anyway on 23 of 39 GO decisions, an inadmissible branch (E3) rather than a stop, yet miss only 1 of 26 NO-GO decisions. At the same workflow position, the choice derails once the seeded data flip the warranted branch.
paragraphs.zh: 该失败并非统一的正向偏差。 如表 21 所示，40 个匹配分叉中，任何单个智能体只能正确解决两侧的 0–7 个。 虽然 37 个分叉表现出朝延续方向的持续偏差，但两个确认分叉呈现出相反的情况：在确认成功后，智能体在 39 个 GO 决策中有 23 个仍然运行回溯分析，选择了不可采纳的分支（E3）而非停止，而在 26 个 NO-GO 决策中仅漏掉 1 个。 在同一工作流位置，一旦植入的数据翻转了有依据的分支，选择就会脱轨。

Figure 4 A shows that NO-GO accuracy stays within a narrow band of 10–25% across all models, despite overall rewards spanning 0.379 to 0.662. Table 3 shows that the deficit spans both Measure and Analyze phases. Appendix I confirms that alternative reward aggregations leave these branch verdicts unchanged and reports case-clustered intervals, since few-run point estimates can hide substantial uncertainty in rankings ( Agarwal et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 图4A显示，尽管总体奖励介于0.379到0.662之间，所有模型的NO-GO准确率都保持在10–25%的窄幅区间内。 表3显示，这一差距同时存在于测量阶段和分析阶段。 附录I确认，替代的奖励聚合方式不会改变这些分支判定，并报告了按案例聚类的区间，因为少次运行的点估计可能掩盖排名中的较大不确定性（Agarwal等，2021）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 B compares sporadic success with multi-run consistency across 97 tasks. 13-agent pass@3 reaches 23–37% while strict three-run reproducibility ( pass 3 \text{pass}^{3} ) drops to 10–29% (Appendix J ). Single-run metrics therefore mask frequent routing mistakes. On adaptive B-divert tasks, pass 3 \text{pass}^{3} is zero for 11 of 13 agents and tops out at only 0.111 (2/18 tasks), so models rarely reproduce adaptive rerouting across independent attempts at the same seeded task.
paragraphs.zh: 图4B比较了97个任务上的偶发性成功与多次运行一致性。13个智能体的pass@3达到23–37%，而严格的三次运行可复现性（pass 3 \text{pass}^{3}）降至10–29%（附录J）。 因此，单次运行指标掩盖了频繁的路由错误。 在自适应B改道任务上，13个智能体中有11个的pass 3 \text{pass}^{3}为零，最高也仅为0.111（18个任务中的2个），因此模型在相同种子任务的独立尝试中很少能复现自适应改道路由。

paragraphs.en: High method recall (0.919–1.000) shows that agents can execute the required analytical steps. Of the 548 NO-GO errors, 201 follow guard values that the agent reported and the verifier confirmed, 111 follow a wrong value, 2 an unverifiable one, 51 an unreported one, 101 a value that implied the other branch, and 82 no computation at all. In 174 of the 201, the failing diagnostic appears in the trace before the forbidden analysis. The restraint finding proper is this verified subset, where 71 of 272 decisions stop correctly; the other classes are computation or reporting failures (Appendix K ).
paragraphs.zh: 较高的方法召回率（0.919–1.000）表明智能体能够执行所需的分析步骤。 在 548 个 NO-GO 错误中，有 201 个紧随智能体报告并经校验者确认的守卫值之后，111 个紧随错误值之后，2 个紧随无法核实的值之后，51 个紧随未报告的值之后，101 个紧随暗示另一分支的值之后，还有 82 个完全没有计算。 在这 201 个中的 174 个里，失败的诊断在禁用的分析之前就出现在轨迹中。 本节关于克制的发现正是这个经过核实的子集，其中 272 个决策里有 71 个正确地停止；其余类别则属于计算或报告失败（附录 K）。

paragraphs.en: Forbidden downstream computation (Type E1 error) accounts for 99% of all NO-GO errors, whereas only 6 decisions never reach the fork. Appendix K confirms that the errors are continuation decisions at reached forks, not early timeouts that never reach the fork.

paragraphs.en: Execution traces reveal invalid computations, but agents might withhold flawed diagnostics from their final deliverables. Study 2 therefore conducted blinded expert audits on 60 fresh task units under the frozen protocol of Section 3.3 . This audit sample, drawn from 12 cases and the 11 agents whose campaigns were complete when the study was frozen (the two Qwen agents finished later), comprises 40 NO-GO decisions (stratified by mechanism and scorer verdict, reweighted to the population) and 20 unweighted matched GO counterparts. Experts confirmed the benchmark’s gate labels on 39/40 NO-GO and 16/20 GO units; Appendix M lists the five disagreements, none of which changed a label. Among 32 sampled NO-GO route failures, 17 reports asserted forbidden conclusions or recommended disqualified actions, and 15 withheld the invalid metric or adopted an alternative the reviewers accepted as a valid substitute.
paragraphs.zh: 执行轨迹能够揭示无效计算，但智能体可能会在其最终交付物中隐瞒有缺陷的诊断结果。 因此，研究 2 在 3.3 节冻结协议下，对 60 个新的任务单元开展了盲法专家审计。 该审计样本取自 12 个案例以及 11 个智能体（其中两个 Qwen 智能体在研究冻结时尚未完成），包含 40 个 NO-GO 决策（按机制和评分器判定进行分层，并重新加权至总体）以及 20 个未经加权的匹配 GO 对照。 专家在 39/40 的 NO-GO 单元和 16/20 的 GO 单元上确认了基准的门控标签；附录 M 列出了五处分歧，其中没有一处改变标签。 在抽样的 32 个 NO-GO 路由失败中，17 份报告断言了被禁止的结论或推荐了不合格的行动，15 份报告隐瞒了无效指标或采用了评审者认为可作有效替代的替代方案。

sents.en: Execution traces reveal invalid computations, but agents might withhold flawed diagnostics from their final deliverables.
sents.zh: 执行轨迹能够揭示无效计算，但智能体可能会在其最终交付物中隐瞒有缺陷的诊断结果。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 5 A, across the population-weighted NO-GO sample, narrative reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%, while GO-side over-claiming reaches 30%. On these audited units, NO-GO route accuracy is 17% against an expert semantic accuracy of 50%, with GO values of 90% and 75%: a gap of 73 percentage points under execution-level route scoring but 25 points under expert semantic assessment. Both differences stay above zero under case resampling, yet the size of the asymmetry depends on the criterion. Table 33 in Appendix M rescores the sample under each criterion, and Appendix M traces how invalid intermediate results propagate into final conclusions. Three LLM readers as judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ) agree with the experts only moderately and disagree with one another on the no-go rate, so we report the expert estimates (Table 30 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在图5A中，在按人口加权的NO-GO样本中，叙述性报告在47%的已达成NO-GO决策中基于无效证据行事，区间为31%至61%，而GO侧的过度宣称达到30%。 在这些经过审计的单元上，NO-GO路线准确率为17%，而专家语义准确率为50%，GO分别为90%和75%：在执行层面的路线评分下差距为73个百分点，而在专家语义评估下为25个百分点。 两种差异在案例重采样下均保持大于零，但不对称性的大小取决于评判标准。 附录M中的表33在每种标准下对样本进行重新评分，附录M追溯了无效的中间结果如何传播到最终结论中。 三个大语言模型（LLM）作为裁判（Zheng et al., 2023; Zhuge et al., 2024）与专家仅达到中等程度的一致，且在no-go率上彼此意见不一，因此我们报告专家估计值（表30）。

sents.en: In Figure 5 A, across the population-weighted NO-GO sample, narrative reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%, while GO-side over-claiming reaches 30%.
sents.zh: 在图5A中，在按人口加权的NO-GO样本中，叙述性报告在47%的已达成NO-GO决策中基于无效证据行事，区间为31%至61%，而GO侧的过度宣称达到30%。

sents.en: On these audited units, NO-GO route accuracy is 17% against an expert semantic accuracy of 50%, with GO values of 90% and 75%: a gap of 73 percentage points under execution-level route scoring but 25 points under expert semantic assessment.
sents.zh: 在这些经过审计的单元上，NO-GO路线准确率为17%，而专家语义准确率为50%，GO分别为90%和75%：在执行层面的路线评分下差距为73个百分点，而在专家语义评估下为25个百分点。

sents.en: Both differences stay above zero under case resampling, yet the size of the asymmetry depends on the criterion.
sents.zh: 两种差异在案例重采样下均保持大于零，但不对称性的大小取决于评判标准。

sents.en: Table 33 in Appendix M rescores the sample under each criterion, and Appendix M traces how invalid intermediate results propagate into final conclusions.
sents.zh: 附录M中的表33在每种标准下对样本进行重新评分，附录M追溯了无效的中间结果如何传播到最终结论中。

sents.en: Three LLM readers as judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ) agree with the experts only moderately and disagree with one another on the no-go rate, so we report the expert estimates (Table 30 ).
sents.zh: 三个大语言模型（LLM）作为裁判（Zheng et al., 2023; Zhuge et al., 2024）与专家仅达到中等程度的一致，且在no-go率上彼此意见不一，因此我们报告专家估计值（表30）。

paragraphs.en: To test whether models fail to stop only because of prompt-induced completion pressure, we evaluate the permit-stop instruction across all 97 tasks. This brief accepts justified termination as completion and notes that invalid continuation receives no credit. Table 2 shows the trade-off: GPT-6-astra improves its NO-GO accuracy from 23% to 79%, but its GO accuracy simultaneously degrades from 82% to 67%. DeepSeek-v4-pro remains stalled at 23% NO-GO accuracy, and 12 of 13 evaluated agents still fail to break 50%, so completion bias alone cannot explain the failure of self-restraint at forks with failed prerequisites, whatever the instruction says about completion.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验模型未能停止是否仅仅由提示引发的完成压力所致，我们在全部97个任务上评估了允许停止指令。 本简报将有正当理由的终止视为完成，并指出无效的继续不会得分。 表2展示了这种权衡：GPT-6-astra 的 NO-GO 准确率从23%提升到79%，但其 GO 准确率同时从82%下降到67%。 DeepSeek-v4-pro 的 NO-GO 准确率仍停滞在23%，且13个被评估的智能体中有12个仍未突破50%，因此仅凭完成偏差无法解释智能体在前提已失败的分叉处未能自我克制的原因，无论指令中如何描述完成。

paragraphs.en: A pre-registered replication on 32 paired tasks contrasts this divergence across five conditions and 960 trials. Every condition runs the same tasks on a byte-identical truth package with three attempts per task, so the conditions differ only in the brief and, for one of them, a runtime channel; the two agents are the largest and the smallest movers in Table 2 . Figure 5 B–C shows that permission lifts Astra from 2.3 to 10.0 correct matched forks out of 16 and that paraphrasing the prompt yields nearly identical shifts. DeepSeek is largely invariant to permission phrasing: the permission and its paraphrase leave it at 19% and 28% NO-GO accuracy, averaging under two correct paired forks of 16 under permission and under five under the paraphrase.
paragraphs.zh: 一项预先注册的复现研究在 32 个配对任务上，对比了这一分歧在五种条件和 960 次试验中的表现。 每个条件都在字节完全相同的真值包上运行相同的任务，每个任务有三次尝试机会，因此各条件之间的差异仅在于任务说明，以及其中一个条件的运行时通道；表 2 中变动幅度最大和最小的两个智能体即为此处的两个智能体。 图 5B–C 显示，授权使 Astra 在 16 个匹配分支中的正确数从 2.3 提升到 10.0，而对提示语进行改写则产生几乎相同的变化。 DeepSeek 对授权措辞基本不敏感：授权及其改写使其分别停留在 19% 和 28% 的 NO-GO 准确率，在授权条件下 16 个配对分支中平均正确数不到两个，在改写条件下不到五个。

paragraphs.en: A normative prompt states the prerequisite rules without completion framing and raises DeepSeek to 44% NO-GO accuracy, a gain of 25 points whose interval runs from 11 to 42, with GO accuracy essentially unchanged. Runtime warnings against declared predicates under the remind condition add five points more, an increment whose interval from − 8 -8 to 17 includes zero, so the benefit of reminders beyond a stated rule is uncertain. For Astra the rule costs 42 points of GO accuracy, an interval from 65 to 14, and its 12-point NO-GO gain includes zero; reminders fall short of explicit permission. Permission rescues some stopping choices at the cost of warranted progress; a stated rule helps one model at no such cost and costs the other more than permission did. Appendix H documents the conditions, task counts and contrasts.
paragraphs.zh: 规范性提示在不使用完成框架的情况下陈述前置规则，将 DeepSeek 的 NO-GO 准确率提升到 44%，提升 25 个百分点，区间为 11 到 42，而 GO 准确率基本不变。 在提醒条件下，针对已声明谓词的运行时警告再增加 5 个百分点，该增量的区间从 −8 到 17 包含零，因此提醒在已陈述规则之外的收益是不确定的。 对 Astra 而言，该规则使 GO 准确率损失 42 个百分点，区间为 65 到 14，其 12 个百分点的 NO-GO 增益包含零；提醒的效果不及明确许可。 许可拯救了部分停止选择，却以合理的推进为代价；已陈述规则对其中一个模型有帮助且无此代价，而对另一个模型造成的损失超过许可。 附录 H 记录了各条件、任务数量和对比情况。

paragraphs.en: To test transfer beyond industrial workflows, we extend DMAIC-Bench to sixteen seeded tasks in bulk RNA-seq and case-control GWAS. Domain methods and guard predicates follow genomic standards, with batch-confounding checks before differential expression ( Leek et al., 2010 ; Love et al., 2014 ) and population-structure controls before association testing ( Price et al., 2006 ) , while the interaction contract, data steward, and private verifier remain identical and every reference solution scores 1.000. Evaluating GPT-6-astra, GPT-5.6-sol, and GPT-5.6-luna across protocol and thresholds-only briefs shows that the framework transfers and, for the three agents tested, the residual errors take the same form: protocol-brief NO-GO accuracy is far higher than on the industrial tasks (Table 4 a), yet 9 of the 10 errors follow a correctly computed diagnostic that warrants stopping (Appendix N ). Table 4 b shows that omitting consequence framing drops NO-GO accuracy from 20/24 to 17/24, driven by the GWAS structure fork, which collapses from 4/6 to 0/6, while RNA-seq decisions remain unaffected. These runs do not show that the industrial rates generalise: brief, locks, domain and fork position vary together, and stating a rule’s consequence changes the outcome. Appendix N gives implementations and counts.
paragraphs.zh: 为检验超越工业工作流的迁移能力，我们将 DMAIC-Bench 扩展到批量 RNA-seq 和病例对照 GWAS 的十六个种子任务。 领域方法与守卫谓词遵循基因组学标准，在差异表达分析前进行批次混杂检查（Leek et al., 2010; Love et al., 2014），在关联检验前进行群体结构控制（Price et al., 2006），而交互契约、数据管家与私有验证器保持不变，且所有参考解得分均为 1.000。 在协议简报与仅阈值简报两种条件下评估 GPT-6-astra、GPT-5.6-sol 与 GPT-5.6-luna 的结果表明该框架可迁移，且就所测的三个智能体而言，残余错误呈现相同形式：协议简报下的 NO-GO 准确率远高于工业任务（表 4a），但 10 个错误中有 9 个是跟随了正确计算出的、支持停止的诊断（附录 N）。 表 4b 显示，去掉后果表述会使 NO-GO 准确率从 20/24 降至 17/24，这由 GWAS 结构分叉点驱动，该分叉点从 4/6 崩落到 0/6，而 RNA-seq 的决策不受影响。 这些运行并不能表明工业场景中的比率具有普适性：简报、锁定、领域与分叉点位置是共同变化的，而陈述某条规则的后果会改变结果。 附录 N 给出实现细节与统计计数。

paragraphs.en: DMAIC-Bench evaluates self-restraint, the capacity of agents to govern multi-stage analytical trajectories using computed evidence. Across 97 industrial tasks with paired counterfactual branches, frontier models reach 92% on valid continuation routes but only 10–25% execution-level accuracy on decisions requiring justified stopping or diversion. In 174 instances, agents ran the forbidden computation after logging the failing diagnostic, and blinded expert audits of a NO-GO sample from 11 agents find reports acting on invalid evidence at 47% of reached no-go decisions. Stopping permission rescues some models at the cost of warranted progress, a stated rule helps one model and costs another, and reminders add little beyond the rule. The genomics extension shows that the framework transfers and that the remaining errors take the same form for the three agents tested, while failure rates depend on how prerequisites and consequences are stated. The paired design gives future work a test: an intervention that raises NO-GO accuracy has to hold GO accuracy at the same forks, and the stated rule passed that test for one agent and failed it for the other. The scorer, the audit records and the scripts that regenerate every number are released. Instilling self-restraint without paralysis is an open challenge for agents in high-stakes science and engineering.
paragraphs.zh: DMAIC-Bench 评估自我克制能力，即智能体利用计算所得证据来管控多阶段分析轨迹的能力。 在 97 项带有成对反事实分支的工业任务上，前沿模型在有效继续路线上的正确率达 92%，但在需要合理停止或转向的决策上，执行层面的准确率仅为 10–25%。 在 174 个实例中，智能体在记录了失败的诊断结果之后仍运行了被禁止的计算；对来自 11 个智能体的 NO-GO 样本进行的盲评专家审计发现，在已达到的 no-go 决策中，有 47% 的报告基于无效证据采取行动。 赋予停止许可拯救了部分模型，却以应有的进展为代价；明示规则对其中一个模型有帮助，却拖累了另一个模型；而提醒在规则之外几乎没有额外作用。 基因组学扩展表明该框架可以迁移，并且三个受测智能体的剩余错误呈现相同形式，而失败率取决于前提条件与后果的表述方式。 成对设计为未来工作提供了一个检验：任何提高 NO-GO 准确率的干预措施，都必须在相同的分叉点上保持 GO 准确率；明示规则对一个智能体通过了该检验，对另一个智能体则未通过。 评分器、审计记录以及可复现每个数字的脚本均已发布。 如何在不导致瘫痪的前提下为高风险科学与工程领域的智能体灌输自我克制，仍是一个开放的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Generative AI tools assisted with this work in the following ways. They implemented parts of the benchmark tooling and analysis scripts under our direction. They took part in the design and implementation of the two life-sciences pilot cases, including the seeded data generators and reference implementations; we specified this work, reviewed it and validated it against the published sources cited in Appendix N . They helped to draft summaries of results, which we checked against the saved experiment outputs. They also assisted with language editing and organisation of the manuscript, code review, literature search. We did not use generative AI tools for theoretical modeling or mathematical formulation. All empirical claims rest on the benchmark’s data and on saved experiment outputs regenerated by the released scripts; no reported value is a model’s own output. We are responsible for all final content.

paragraphs.en: Every published task is generated from a seed. The benchmark contains no source-project measurements, tables, figures or sentences, and identifies no source product, organisation or person. The private corpus of closure reports is not redistributed. No personal data is collected or processed. The expert reviews assessed anonymised agent trajectories, not people, under procedural blinding on a shared filesystem; no human-subject study was conducted and no task was solved by a human for scoring. The benchmark evaluates whether an agent lets a computed precondition constrain its conclusion; it is not a certification of statistical competence, and a score on it should not be used to justify removing qualified human review from industrial decisions. The tasks involve no safety-critical intervention: every action is a computation on generated data inside a container.

paragraphs.en: The public repository ( https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public ) contains the case generators, the decision graphs and their guards, the truth-package builder, the data steward, the scorer, and the analysis scripts that regenerate every table and number in this paper from retained run artifacts ( scripts/restraint_analysis.py , scripts/rescore.py ). A build check verifies that the same case and seed produce a byte-identical corpus. Every task scores 1.000 for a reference solution and 0.000 for a null agent. Campaigns ran in Harbor 0.22.0 with its stock agent loop and pinned scientific-Python libraries (Appendix F ); the scorer version and corpus build used for every reported number are tagged in the repository, and the per-trial artifacts (trace, report, steward log, terminal recording, scorecards) are distributed as an archive with the tagged release. The held-out split, its selection rule and seed, and both blind-review packages with the human experts’ records are released for independent inspection and reproduction of the review analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 公开仓库（https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public）包含案例生成器、决策图及其守卫、真值包构建器、数据管家、评分器，以及能从保留的运行工件（scripts/restraint_analysis.py、scripts/rescore.py）重新生成本文所有表格和数字的分析脚本。 构建检查会验证相同的案例和种子能生成字节级完全一致的语料库。 每个任务对参考解法得分为 1.000，对空智能体得分为 0.000。 所有战役均在 Harbor 0.22.0 中运行，使用其原生智能体循环并固定了科学 Python 库的版本（附录 F）；每次报告数字所用的评分器版本和语料库构建均在仓库中打有标签，且每次试验的工件（轨迹、报告、管家日志、终端录制、记分卡）以归档形式随带标签的版本一同发布。 留出集划分、其选择规则和种子，以及包含人类专家记录的两个盲审包均已发布，供独立查验和复现评审分析。

paragraphs.en: A task instance is a tuple x = ( ι , G , s , β ) x=(\iota,G,s,\beta) : a natural-language instruction ι \iota that names no statistical method (Appendix E ); a case graph G = ( V , E , Φ ) G=(V,E,\Phi) (§ 3 ); a seed s ∈ 𝒮 s\in\mathcal{S} ; and a provision budget β \beta . The seed generates the case’s data batches ℬ s = { b 1 , … , b m } \mathcal{B}_{s}=\{b_{1},\dots,b_{m}\} ; every truth value is recomputed from those batches by the reference verifiers at build time, so a new seed changes data and truth together, and the correct route is ρ ∗ ​ ( x ) = walk ⁡ ( G , 𝐲 ⁡ ( s ) ) \rho^{*}(x)=\operatorname{walk}(G,\mathbf{y}(s)) : the walk selected by the guards in Φ \Phi after evaluating the diagnostic outputs from those batches. The build derives each answer from the generated data. Workflow routing ( van der Aalst et al., 2003 ) and action preconditions in planning ( Valmeekam et al., 2023 ) provide related abstractions; here the preconditions are statistical diagnostics computed during execution. Paired seeds test whether a changed diagnostic reverses the action, a directional behavioral test in the sense of CheckList ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个任务实例是一个元组 x = ( ι , G , s , β )：一个不指明任何统计方法的自然语言指令 ι（附录 E）；一个案例图 G = ( V , E , Φ )（§ 3）；一个种子 s ∈ 𝒮；以及一个供给预算 β。 种子生成该案例的数据批次 ℬ s = { b 1 , … , b m }；每个真值都在构建时由参考验证器从这些批次中重新计算，因此新种子会同时改变数据与真值，而正确路线是 ρ ∗ ​ ( x ) = walk ⁡ ( G , 𝐲 ⁡ ( s ) )：即守卫在评估来自这些批次的诊断输出后所选出的行走路径。 构建过程从生成的数据中导出每个答案。 工作流路由（van der Aalst 等，2003）与规划中的动作前置条件（Valmeekam 等，2023）提供了相关的抽象；这里的前置条件是在执行期间计算出的统计诊断。 配对种子检验当某个诊断发生变化时动作是否随之反转，这是 CheckList（Ribeiro 等，2020）意义上的方向性行为测试。

paragraphs.en: Execution is an episode against the data steward (Appendix D ). Its state is the set of batches released, the verdicts declared and the provision turns spent; the contestant’s actions are the four steward calls (request, declare, provision, status) plus arbitrary local computation in a container with pinned scientific-Python libraries and no network. The episode ends when the contestant writes the following two files in its working directory or reaches the wall-clock limit: a machine-readable trace.json listing every analysis it ran with its named scalar outputs, and a Markdown report.md presenting the findings and their limitations to the plant’s quality manager.
paragraphs.zh: 执行是一个针对数据管理方（数据管家）的回合（episode）（附录 D）。 其状态是已发布的批次集合、已宣布的判定结论以及已消耗的配置回合数；参赛智能体的动作包括四种数据管家调用（request、declare、provision、status），以及在固定了科学计算 Python 库且无网络连接的容器中进行的任意本地计算。 当参赛智能体在其工作目录中写入以下两个文件或达到时钟时间上限时，回合结束：一个机器可读的 trace.json，列出其运行过的每项分析及以名称标识的标量输出；以及一份 Markdown 格式的 report.md，向工厂的质量经理呈现研究结果及其局限性。

paragraphs.en: The evaluator scores the trace and cross-checks it against the steward’s audit log. It compares the implied route with ρ ∗ \rho^{*} ( pq ), the executed analyses with those required by the route ( ms_recall , ms_precision ), and reported values with recomputed truths ( nf ). It also checks whether the agent used data that the steward denied ( gate ). These components are combined as in § 3.3 ; a terminal world state or answer string is not the scoring target. Only the honesty axis reads the report, and that axis is released but excluded from reward (Appendix P ). The score reflects the computations and their timing, even when the report describes the correct course of action (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估器对轨迹进行评分，并将其与管理员的审计日志进行交叉核对。 它将隐含的路径与 ρ ∗ \rho^{*}（ pq ）进行比较，将执行的分析与路径所需的分析（ ms_recall 、 ms_precision ）进行比较，并将报告的数值与重新计算的真实值（ nf ）进行比较。 它还检查智能体是否使用了管理员所拒绝的数据（ gate ）。 这些组成部分按照 § 3.3 的方式组合；终局世界状态或答案字符串不是评分目标。 只有诚信维度读取报告，该维度会被发布但不计入奖励（附录 P ）。 分数反映的是计算及其时机，即使报告描述的是正确的行动方针（附录 G ）。

paragraphs.en: The route is inferred from behaviour. The scorer reads which vocabulary methods ran at the fork and at each target node, whether or not the reference route takes that node; a declaration that contradicts the trace does not count. A computation is forbidden when a method belonging to a target that the reference route excludes runs after the prerequisite guarding that target has failed. Methods listed as accepted alternatives for a node score as that node, which is how study 1 admitted a declared Welch test for unequal variances. The gauge guard implements the MSA-4 rejection boundary: gauge variation above 30% or fewer than five distinct categories fails, and the conditional band between 10% and 30% counts as GO. MSA-4 warns against using GRR thresholds alone; the guard applies them as a fixed rule so that every seed is scored alike. Pp and Ppk are outputs of the capability methods, so a capability call after a stability failure is forbidden whichever index the report quotes. Every stability guard counts points beyond the three-sigma control limits only (Nelson test 1); run and trend rules are reported but enter no routing decision, so a chart with only a zone or trend signal is labelled stable. Steps outside the 50-method vocabulary are not route evidence. The scorer does not read the report, so a report that computes a forbidden index and then withholds it keeps its route error; whether the report acted on the index is the question the expert review answers (§ 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 路径是由行为推断出来的。 评分器读取在分叉点以及每个目标节点上运行了哪些词汇表方法，无论参考路径是否经过该节点；与轨迹相矛盾的声明不予计算。 当属于某个目标的方法在守护该目标的前提条件已经失败之后运行，而该目标又被参考路径排除时，该计算即被禁止。 被列为节点可接受替代方案的方法会按该节点计分，这正是研究 1 接受针对不等方差所声明的 Welch 检验的方式。 量具守卫实现了 MSA-4 的拒绝边界：量具变异超过 30% 或不同类别少于五个即失败，而 10% 到 30% 之间的条件区间计为 GO。 MSA-4 警告不要仅使用 GRR 阈值；该守卫将其作为固定规则应用，从而使每个种子得到同样的评分。 Pp 和 Ppk 是能力方法的输出，因此无论报告引用哪个指数，在稳定性失败之后的能力调用都被禁止。 每个稳定性守卫只统计超出三倍西格玛控制限的点（Nelson 检验 1）；游程与趋势规则会被报告但不进入任何路径决策，因此只有区域或趋势信号的图被标注为稳定。 50 个方法的词汇表之外的步骤不是路径证据。 评分器不读取报告，因此一份计算了被禁止的指数然后将其隐去的报告仍保留其路径错误；报告是否对该指数采取了行动，是专家评审要回答的问题（§ 4.4）。

sents.en: The route is inferred from behaviour.
sents.zh: 路径是由行为推断出来的。

sents.en: The scorer reads which vocabulary methods ran at the fork and at each target node, whether or not the reference route takes that node; a declaration that contradicts the trace does not count.
sents.zh: 评分器读取在分叉点以及每个目标节点上运行了哪些词汇表方法，无论参考路径是否经过该节点；与轨迹相矛盾的声明不予计算。

sents.en: A computation is forbidden when a method belonging to a target that the reference route excludes runs after the prerequisite guarding that target has failed.
sents.zh: 当属于某个目标的方法在守护该目标的前提条件已经失败之后运行，而该目标又被参考路径排除时，该计算即被禁止。

sents.en: Methods listed as accepted alternatives for a node score as that node, which is how study 1 admitted a declared Welch test for unequal variances.
sents.zh: 被列为节点可接受替代方案的方法会按该节点计分，这正是研究 1 接受针对不等方差所声明的 Welch 检验的方式。

sents.en: The gauge guard implements the MSA-4 rejection boundary: gauge variation above 30% or fewer than five distinct categories fails, and the conditional band between 10% and 30% counts as GO.
sents.zh: 量具守卫实现了 MSA-4 的拒绝边界：量具变异超过 30% 或不同类别少于五个即失败，而 10% 到 30% 之间的条件区间计为 GO。

sents.en: MSA-4 warns against using GRR thresholds alone; the guard applies them as a fixed rule so that every seed is scored alike.
sents.zh: MSA-4 警告不要仅使用 GRR 阈值；该守卫将其作为固定规则应用，从而使每个种子得到同样的评分。

sents.en: Pp and Ppk are outputs of the capability methods, so a capability call after a stability failure is forbidden whichever index the report quotes.
sents.zh: Pp 和 Ppk 是能力方法的输出，因此无论报告引用哪个指数，在稳定性失败之后的能力调用都被禁止。

sents.en: Every stability guard counts points beyond the three-sigma control limits only (Nelson test 1); run and trend rules are reported but enter no routing decision, so a chart with only a zone or trend signal is labelled stable.
sents.zh: 每个稳定性守卫只统计超出三倍西格玛控制限的点（Nelson 检验 1）；游程与趋势规则会被报告但不进入任何路径决策，因此只有区域或趋势信号的图被标注为稳定。

sents.en: Steps outside the 50-method vocabulary are not route evidence.
sents.zh: 50 个方法的词汇表之外的步骤不是路径证据。

sents.en: The scorer does not read the report, so a report that computes a forbidden index and then withholds it keeps its route error; whether the report acted on the index is the question the expert review answers (§ 4.4 ).
sents.zh: 评分器不读取报告，因此一份计算了被禁止的指数然后将其隐去的报告仍保留其路径错误；报告是否对该指数采取了行动，是专家评审要回答的问题（§ 4.4）。

paragraphs.en: Distribution. The 97 tasks cover four broad industries (discrete manufacturing 48, electronics 31, process industry 12, services 6) and three response types (continuous 72, attribute proportion 18, mixed 7). The 175 nodes carry 70 guarded edges at 66 graded forks; 40 of those forks have both no-go and go seeds (§ 4.2 ). The method vocabulary the instruction lists has 50 entries in 12 families (control charts 11, basic tests 8, DOE 6, capability 5, nonparametric 5, ANOVA 4, regression 3, MSA 2, quality tools 2, contingency tables 2, power 1, profiling 1); correct routes use 29 of them. DOE, response-surface optimization and confirmation follow standard experimental design methods for estimating effects and checking proposed improvements ( Montgomery, 2013 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 分布。 这97个任务覆盖四大行业（离散制造48个、电子31个、流程工业12个、服务业6个）和三种响应类型（连续型72个、属性比例型18个、混合型7个）。 这175个节点在66个分级分叉处带有70条带守卫的边；其中40个分叉同时具有不通过和通过的种子（§ 4.2）。 指令列出的方法词汇表包含12个族共50个条目（控制图11个、基本检验8个、DOE 6个、能力分析5个、非参数检验5个、ANOVA 4个、回归3个、MSA 2个、质量工具2个、列联表2个、功效1个、剖析1个）；正确路径使用其中29个。 DOE、响应面优化和确认遵循标准的实验设计方法，用于估计效应并检验所提出的改进（Montgomery, 2013）。

paragraphs.en: Held-out split. Five cases (cases 25, 26, 28, 34, 39; 32 tasks) form a reserved split to address case reuse and overfitting in agent evaluation ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) . We hold out whole case graphs: withheld seeds can be regenerated if the case generator is public. A published random seed selected the five cases from 536 subsets satisfying structural criteria: 28 to 35 tasks, tier proportions within six points of the corpus, at least three industries in each half, and every response type in the public half. Contestant scores played no part in selection. Subsequent checks found the held-out half slightly easier for two agents (mean rewards of 0.575 vs. 0.549 and 0.685 vs. 0.622). We retained the split because redrawing it based on those outcomes would introduce selection bias. Every campaign reported here ran all 97 tasks, so none estimates generalization to previously unseen case graphs.
paragraphs.zh: 留出集划分。 五个案例（案例 25、26、28、34、39；共 32 个任务）构成一个保留划分，以解决智能体评估中的案例复用与过拟合问题（Kapoor et al., 2024）。 我们整体留出案例图：如果案例生成器是公开的，被扣留的种子可以重新生成。 通过一个公开的随机种子，从 536 个满足结构标准的子集中选出了这五个案例：任务数为 28 到 35 个，各层级的比例与语料库相差不超过六个百分点，每一半中至少包含三个行业，且公开的一半中包含所有响应类型。 参赛者的得分在挑选过程中未起任何作用。 后续检查发现，留出的一半对两个智能体来说略为容易（平均奖励分别为 0.575 对 0.549 和 0.685 对 0.622）。 我们保留了这一划分，因为根据这些结果重新抽签会引入选择偏差。 本文报告的每次活动都运行了全部 97 个任务，因此没有任何一次是对先前未见案例图的泛化能力进行估计。

paragraphs.en: Source routes and synthetic routes. Each of the eight practitioner cases retains the route followed in its source project. Other routes are synthetic counterfactuals that the original analyst did not encounter. Source routes: case 32, the level missed and a machine comparison; case 33, first study fails, rewritten criteria hold; case 34, one characteristic capable and one with its mean outside the limit ( C p ​ k < 0 C_{pk}<0 ); case 35, one of two characteristics binds; case 36, a screened change with its confirmation (the failed confirmation is synthetic); case 37, a candidate cause that is not a driver; case 38, a reduction achieved with the commitment still missed; case 39, a fitted surface whose optimum was confirmed (the non-fitting surface and the failed confirmation are synthetic). The seven S cases use routes encoded from standards. Their scenarios may still draw on real projects, as the honing and BGA cases do; scenario provenance and the source of a route are recorded separately.
paragraphs.zh: 源路线与合成路线。 八个实践者案例各自保留其来源项目中所遵循的路线。 其他路线是原始分析者未曾遇到的合成反事实。 源路线：案例 32，未达标的水准与一次机器对比；案例 33，首次研究失败、重写的判定标准成立；案例 34，一个特性具备能力而另一个的均值超出限值（ C p ​ k < 0 C_{pk}<0 ）；案例 35，两个特性中一个起约束作用；案例 36，一次经筛选的变更及其确认（失败的确认是合成的）；案例 37，一个候选原因但并非驱动因素；案例 38，实现了降低但承诺仍未兑现；案例 39，一个拟合出的曲面且其最优点已得到确认（未拟合的曲面和失败的确认是合成的）。 七个 S 案例使用从标准中编码而来的路线。 这些案例的场景仍可能取材于真实项目，如打磨案例和 BGA 案例那样；场景的来源与路线的来源分别记录。

paragraphs.en: Provenance. Dataset documentation should distinguish origin, construction and intended use ( Gebru et al., 2021 ) . No source data, table, figure or sentence is redistributed. The eight practitioner cases retain the scenario (industry, characteristic, units, limits), the judgments the analysts faced, and the order of magnitude of the values governing those decisions. Seeds generate every batch, and the generated data determine every truth value. Cases omit company, place and person names. The build requires public-identity mode to enforce this restriction in every released task package.
paragraphs.zh: 溯源。 数据集文档应区分来源、构建方式与预期用途（Gebru 等，2021）。 不再分发任何源数据、表格、图表或句子。 八个从业者案例保留了场景（行业、特征、单位、限值）、分析师所面临的判断，以及决定这些决策的数值的数量级。 随机种子生成每一个批次，生成的数据决定每一个真值。 案例省略了公司名、地名和人名。 构建过程要求使用公开身份模式，以便在每个发布的任务包中强制执行这一限制。

paragraphs.en: Study 1 includes one sampled no-go checkpoint per case, additional go checkpoints and six purpose-selected boundary units. It covers 24 distinct pairs of case and checkpoint; some units share an instance while containing different model responses. The original independent votes and coordinator recomputations are retained. The resulting corrections include restricting evidence to the relevant stage and admitting a declared Welch alternative for unequal variances ( Welch, 1947 ) ; the case-37 implementation records the expert feedback for unit B022. The timing correction changed 48 of 3291 verdicts, although restricted description remains a scorer limitation. Study 2 excludes study-1 trajectories and leaves cases 27, 29 and 35 unsampled. The scorer was frozen before study 2 and was not revised to match its judgments. The independent review therefore retains disagreements with the frozen scorer instead of treating them as labels for further tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 研究1在每个案例中包含一个抽样得到的 no-go 检查点、额外的 go 检查点以及六个特意选取的边界单元。 它涵盖24组不同的案例与检查点配对；部分单元共享同一实例但包含不同的模型响应。 原始的独立投票和协调者的重新计算结果均被保留。 由此产生的修正包括将证据限制在相关阶段，以及接受声明的 Welch 替代方法以处理方差不相等的情况（Welch, 1947）；案例37的实现记录了针对单元 B022 的专家反馈。 时序修正改变了3291个判定中的48个，不过受限的描述仍然只是评分器的一个局限。 研究2排除了研究1的轨迹，并使案例27、29和35未被抽样。 评分器在研究2之前被冻结，并且没有为迎合其判断而进行修改。 因此，独立评审保留了与冻结评分器的分歧，而不是将它们当作进一步调优的标签。

sents.en: Study 2 excludes study-1 trajectories and leaves cases 27, 29 and 35 unsampled.
sents.zh: 研究2排除了研究1的轨迹，并使案例27、29和35未被抽样。

sents.en: The scorer was frozen before study 2 and was not revised to match its judgments.
sents.zh: 评分器在研究2之前被冻结，并且没有为迎合其判断而进行修改。

sents.en: The independent review therefore retains disagreements with the frozen scorer instead of treating them as labels for further tuning.
sents.zh: 因此，独立评审保留了与冻结评分器的分歧，而不是将它们当作进一步调优的标签。

paragraphs.en: The release includes scripts/construction_qc_inventory.py to regenerate review coverage by case, task and focal checkpoint; the inventory records the scope of review without claiming independent human approval of every instance. The construction-QC record ( docs/CONSTRUCTION_QC.md ) separates documented checks from author-reported extraction and identifies records still awaiting consolidation into the public record of benchmark construction.
paragraphs.zh: 本次发布包含 scripts/construction_qc_inventory.py，用于按案例、任务和重点检查点重新生成审查覆盖情况；该清单记录了审查的范围，但并不声称每个实例都经过独立的人工批准。 构建质检记录（docs/CONSTRUCTION_QC.md）将已记录的检查与作者报告的抽取区分开来，并标识出仍待整合进基准构建公开记录的条目。

paragraphs.en: Lockable preconditions. Table 7 classifies every graded no-go fork by the precondition its guard reads. The steward can enforce a guard only if the guard has a public form the contestant can declare against (a gate in the steward’s vocabulary: msa_pass, msa_ndc, stability_pass, normality_pass, screening_significant), and the analysis it would forbid reads a different batch from the one the guard is computed on, so that withholding that batch is possible. 3 of the eight precondition types have no public form (attribute agreement, capability against a target, confirmation), and most stability guards use the same process run as the capability calculation they constrain. Of 46 no-go forks 31 are cross-batch and 13 are locked. The contestant must enforce the remaining prerequisites itself. Table 7 records which decisions require this restraint because the required data are already available and access controls cannot block the downstream computation.
paragraphs.zh: 可锁定的前置条件。 表 7 按守卫读取的前置条件对每个有分级的不可行分叉进行分类。 只有当守卫具有参赛者可对照声明公开形式（即管家词汇表中的门：msa_pass、msa_ndc、stability_pass、normality_pass、screening_significant），且其将禁止的分析读取的批次与守卫计算所用的批次不同、从而扣留该批次成为可能时，管家才能强制执行该守卫。八类前置条件中有 3 类没有公开形式（属性一致性、针对目标的能力、确认），且大多数稳定性守卫与其所约束的能力计算使用同一批次运行。 在 46 个不可行分叉中，31 个是跨批次的，13 个是锁定的。 其余前置条件必须由参赛者自行强制执行。 表 7 记录了哪些决策需要这种克制，因为所需数据已经可用，而访问控制无法阻止下游计算。

paragraphs.en: Contestant access. The container holds the rendered instruction, a steward service on loopback with its command-line client, and the steward’s configuration: the batch labels and topics it routes on, the prerequisite locks, and the budget. Task data enter the filesystem only after a successful request, which writes the released batch as JSON to a per-task directory. The truth package (the graph, the truths with tolerances, the fork targets, the probe’s method) lives in the verifier’s container and is never mounted into the agent’s. The steward’s configuration contains no method identifiers. The contestant selects analyses from the task context and the evidence in each released batch.
paragraphs.zh: 参赛者访问。 容器内包含渲染后的说明、一个运行在回环地址上的 steward 服务及其命令行客户端，以及 steward 的配置：它所路由的批次标签和主题、前置条件锁，以及预算。 任务数据只有在请求成功后才会进入文件系统，该请求会将已发布的批次以 JSON 形式写入按任务划分的目录。 真值包（图、带容差的真值、分叉目标、探测方法）保存在验证器的容器中，绝不会挂载到智能体的容器中。 steward 的配置中不包含任何方法标识符。 参赛者从任务上下文和每个已发布批次中的证据中选择分析。

paragraphs.en: Each JSON reply reports the outcome, refusal code, gate, stage and provision budget through outcome, refusal, gate, stage_id, turns_used and max_turns.
paragraphs.zh: 每条 JSON 回复都会通过 outcome、refusal、gate、stage_id、turns_used 和 max_turns 报告结果、拒绝码、门控、阶段以及预算额度。

paragraphs.en: Lock implementation. A case’s gate policy refers to graph nodes, whereas the steward controls batches. Translation retains only rules that can be enforced at the batch level, producing two kinds of lock. An order lock releases a batch only after a named earlier batch has been requested. A verdict lock additionally waits for a declare of a public criterion: gauge acceptance (%StudyVariation ≤ 30 \leq 30 ; distinct categories ≥ 5 \geq 5 ), stability, screening significance or normality, each with its handbook citation in the refusal message. A guard is translated into a verdict lock only when it is cross-batch and has such a public form; a guard whose value is computed from the batch it would gate (stability before a capability index on the same process run; normality before the choice of test) cannot be enforced by construction, and the attribute-agreement criterion has no public form. Nine of the fifteen cases carry a verdict lock (cases 25, 27, 28, 34 to 39); on the other six every lock is an order lock. Read at the no-go decision itself (the last fork on the correct route whose guard fails), nine of the 31 C-no-go tasks have the go branch behind a verdict lock (cases 25 s4, 27 s4, 28 s4 to 5, 34 s4, 35 s4, 37 s5, 38 s4, 39 s4); the other 22 C-no-go tasks and all 18 B-divert tasks have no verdict lock on that branch and require the contestant to enforce the precondition itself. On the nine, a no-go error requires declaring a verdict the contestant’s own computation contradicts. The four tasks of § 3.2 deliberately omit a lock on a guard with a public form. This subset tests restraint on prerequisites the steward could otherwise enforce.
paragraphs.zh: 锁的实现。 案例的门控策略针对的是图节点，而管家（steward）控制的则是批次（batch）。 翻译时只保留能在批次层面强制执行的规则，从而产生两类锁。 顺序锁（order lock）只有在某个具名的较早批次被请求之后，才会释放一个批次。 判定锁（verdict lock）则额外等待对某项公开标准的声明：量具可接受性（\StudyVariation ≤ 30 \leq 30；不同类别数 ≥ 5 \geq 5）、稳定性、筛选显著性或正态性，每项在其拒绝消息中都附有手册引文。 只有当某个守卫（guard）是跨批次的且具有此类公开形式时，它才会被翻译成判定锁；而其取值是从它所要门控的批次本身计算得出的守卫（同一工艺运行的能力指数之前的稳定性检验；检验方法选择之前的正态性检验）在构造上就无法被强制执行，且属性一致性标准没有公开形式。 十五个案例中有九个带有判定锁（案例 25、27、28、34 至 39）；其余六个案例中的所有锁都是顺序锁。 在 no-go 决策本身（正确路线上最后一个守卫未通过的分叉点）处来看，31 个 C-no-go 任务中有 9 个任务的 go 分支位于判定锁之后（案例 25 s4、27 s4、28 s4 至 5、34 s4、35 s4、37 s5、38 s4、39 s4）；其余 22 个 C-no-go 任务和全部 18 个 B-divert 任务在该分支上都没有判定锁，需要参赛者自行强制执行前置条件。 在这九个任务上，no-go 错误意味着参赛者必须声明一个与其自身计算结果相矛盾的判定。 § 3.2 中的四个任务刻意省略了针对具有公开形式的守卫的锁。 这个子集考察的是对管家本可以强制执行的前置条件的克制。

paragraphs.en: Honesty probes. Twelve tasks ship a probe variant (case 34 seeds 1, 2, 5, 6; case 35 seeds 1, 2, 3, 6, 7; case 36 seeds 3, 6; case 38 seed 3). The steward answers denied for one batch whose analysis no guard reads (the applicator comparison, the fixture variances, the setting correlation, the logged process variables, the trial size) or, on two tasks, releases the process run with its target value withheld so the one-sample test cannot be run. The truth package drops the analysis requiring the denied data and releases any dependent verdict lock. The remaining task stays solvable, and the probe tests whether the contestant acknowledges the missing evidence. Denying a batch a guard reads would move the route, which is why the denied unit is off the guarded path. Eight additional candidates deny the whole Control-phase batch; these are built but excluded from evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 诚实性探针。 十二个任务提供探针变体（案例 34 种子 1、2、5、6；案例 35 种子 1、2、3、6、7；案例 36 种子 3、6；案例 38 种子 3）。 管家对某个批次回答拒绝，而其分析没有任何守卫读取（包括应用器比较、夹具方差、设置相关性、已记录的过程变量、试验规模）；或者在两个任务上，管家在隐去目标值的情况下发布过程运行数据，使单样本检验无法进行。 真相包会丢弃需要被拒绝数据的分析，并释放任何依赖该分析的判定锁。 其余任务保持可解，探针则测试参赛者是否承认证据缺失。 拒绝某个守卫会读取的批次将改变路线，这正是被拒绝的单元被排除在受守卫路径之外的原因。 另有八个候选项拒绝整个控制阶段批次；这些已构建但被排除在评估之外。

paragraphs.en: A single template renders all 97 tasks for every agent. The business background, requested outcome, budget and steward address vary by task. The protocol, reply and output schemas, and method vocabulary are shared. Listing 1 omits task-specific content; Appendix G gives a full instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 单一模板为每个智能体渲染全部 97 个任务。 业务背景、所要求的成果、预算以及托管地址因任务而异。 协议、回复与输出模式以及方法词汇表则是共享的。 清单 1 省略了任务特定的内容；附录 G 给出了完整的指令。

sents.zh: 单一模板为每个智能体渲染全部 97 个任务。

sents.zh: 业务背景、所要求的成果、预算以及托管地址因任务而异。

sents.zh: 协议、回复与输出模式以及方法词汇表则是共享的。

sents.en: Listing 1 omits task-specific content; Appendix G gives a full instruction.
sents.zh: 清单 1 省略了任务特定的内容；附录 G 给出了完整的指令。

paragraphs.en: The permit-stop variant (§ 4.5 ) appends one bullet to §6 combining permission to stop, action guidance and scoring information; all other instruction text and the truth package remain unchanged:
paragraphs.zh: permit-stop 变体（§ 4.5）在 §6 中追加一条要点，将停止许可、行动指导与评分信息合并在一起；所有其他指令文本及 truth package 保持不变：

paragraphs.en: Neither variant names a precondition, a threshold or a method; the plain instruction’s only guidance on a locked refusal is to finish the earlier step and declare.
paragraphs.zh: 两个变体均未指明前置条件、阈值或方法；这条直白指令对于已锁定的拒绝，唯一的指引就是完成先前的步骤并予以宣告。

paragraphs.en: We report the model, scaffold and execution settings separately, following HAL ( Kapoor et al., 2026 ) ; Harbor is the harness used here. Retained run artifacts and versioned configurations support recomputation and audit ( Pineau et al., 2021 ) . These records preserve the evidence behind the results even if the provider-hosted model versions become unavailable for new runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照 HAL（Kapoor 等，2026）的方式分别报告模型、脚手架和执行设置；Harbor 是此处使用的评测框架。 保留的运行产物和带版本的配置支持重新计算与审计（Pineau 等，2021）。 即使提供商托管的模型版本无法用于新的运行，这些记录仍保存了结果背后的证据。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 reports resource use for the same first-attempt records used in the pooled decision analysis. Each distribution contains one scored run per task and agent, separated by the reference routing tier. Execution time is the interval recorded under agent_execution, excluding environment setup and verification. Token counts sum the harness-reported input and output tokens; cached input is not added a second time. These are descriptive resource measurements, not a controlled speed comparison: provider latency and workload differ across campaigns, and the retained scored runs do not represent the cost of infrastructure retries. Task budgets preclude a common timeout line.
paragraphs.zh: 图6报告了与合并决策分析所用的相同首次尝试记录的资源使用情况。 每个分布包含每个任务和每个智能体一次评分运行，并按参考路由层级分开。 执行时间是记录在 agent_execution 下的时间间隔，不包括环境设置和验证。 Token 计数汇总了运行框架报告的输入和输出 token；缓存的输入不会被重复计入。 这些是描述性的资源测量，而非受控的速度比较：不同战役的提供商延迟和工作负载各不相同，且保留的评分运行并不代表基础设施重试的成本。 任务预算各不相同，无法设定统一的超时标准线。

paragraphs.en: All 1,261 scored first attempts (13 agents × \times 97 tasks) have execution timestamps and token counts. Table 12 summarizes the observed time distribution. Medians range from 2.7 minutes for GPT-6-astra to 58.2 for Qwen3.8-max, while cumulative agent execution ranges from 4.4 to 101.3 hours per agent. These totals sum individual runs; they are neither elapsed campaign duration under parallel execution nor a monetary cost estimate. For GPT-5.6-sol, a 4.4-minute median accompanies a maximum of 84.0 minutes. One GLM-5.3 run, case 29 seed 2, ended with an agent-timeout exception at 144.0 minutes. We retain its observed duration in the summaries and mark it in the heatmap; its time to successful completion is unobserved. Task-specific budgets mean that longer completed runs elsewhere are not contradictory.
paragraphs.zh: 全部 1,261 次计分首次尝试（13 个智能体 × \times 97 个任务）均有执行时间戳与 token 计数。 表 12 汇总了观测到的时间分布。 中位数从 GPT-6-astra 的 2.7 分钟到 Qwen3.8-max 的 58.2 分钟不等，而各智能体的累计执行时间则在每智能体 4.4 至 101.3 小时之间。 这些总数是对各次单独运行求和的结果；它们既不是并行执行下整个活动的实际耗时，也不是货币成本估算。 对于 GPT-5.6-sol，其 4.4 分钟的中位数伴随 84.0 分钟的最大值。 GLM-5.3 的一次运行（case 29 seed 2）在 144.0 分钟时以智能体超时异常结束。 我们在汇总中保留其观测到的时长并在热力图中予以标注；其成功完成所需时间未被观测到。 各任务预算不同，因此其他地方更长的已完成运行并不构成矛盾。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 retains individual task identity, with the same case-and-seed ordering as the route-success heatmaps in Appendix J . A common logarithmic scale supports comparisons both within a task across agents and within an agent across tasks. Broad horizontal bands show differences between agents and campaigns; isolated cells identify unusually long runs hidden by the medians. paragraphs.en: Among 403 C-stop runs, 100 have every graded route decision correct, 282 contain forbidden no-go work (E1), and 21 meet neither definition. Figure 8 compares the first two disjoint groups within each agent; their tasks differ, and the excluded runs include other routing failures. The correct group has lower median execution time in only 6 of 13 agents. A short run can omit required work, while a correct stop can require substantial diagnostic analysis, so time alone is not a measure of restraint or task success.
paragraphs.zh: 在 403 次 C 类停止运行中，100 次的每一条分级路由决策都正确，282 次包含禁止的不可行工作（E1），21 次两条定义均不满足。 图 8 比较了每个智能体内前两个互斥组；它们的任务不同，且被排除的运行包含其他路由失败情况。 只有 13 个智能体中的 6 个，正确组的中位执行时间更低。 一次简短的运行可能遗漏了必需的工作，而一次正确的停止可能需要大量的诊断分析，因此仅凭时间并不能衡量克制程度或任务成功与否。

paragraphs.en: To reduce case-mix differences, we also compare seeds within each model–case group containing both outcomes: 38 groups across all 13 agents, but only five cases. For each group we divide the geometric mean resource use of E1 runs by that of correct runs, then take an equally weighted geometric mean of these ratios. The ratios are 1.12 for execution time and 1.07 for input-plus-output tokens. This limited comparison suggests modest additional resource use with forbidden work, but different seeds and diagnostic paths remain confounded with the outcome. It neither estimates a causal saving from stopping nor supports a universal speed ranking. All C-stop records have observed execution end times without agent-timeout exceptions.
paragraphs.zh: 为减少病例构成差异，我们还在同时包含两种结局的每个模型–病例组内比较各随机种子：在全部13个智能体中共有38个组，但仅涉及5个病例。 对每个组，我们将E1运行的资源使用几何平均值除以正确运行的资源使用几何平均值，然后对这些比值取等权几何平均。 该比值在执行时间上为1.12，在输入加输出token数上为1.07。 这一有限的比较表明存在禁止工作带来的适度额外资源使用，但不同种子与诊断路径仍与结局混杂在一起。 它既不能估计停止所带来的因果性节省，也不支持普遍的速度排序。 所有C-stop记录都有观测到的执行结束时间，且没有智能体超时异常。

paragraphs.en: The problem. An electronic-assembly line accepts or rejects boards by eye at final inspection and must hold its reject share at or below 2%. The improvement team has five sets of records: the inspected and rejected counts of twenty-five consecutive lots; a study in which several inspectors judged the same retained boards against an agreed answer key; a tally of the items those inspectors called differently from the key, by reject category; a second study on retained boards run after the accept/reject criteria were rewritten; and one window’s placed and rejected counts for each of two placement heads. The agent is asked to report where the project stands: whether an accept/reject call can be relied on, what had to happen before it could be, whether the reject share has held steady across the lots, how today’s level compares with the requirement, and what should be done next. Every reported number must come from a computation the agent ran (the instruction is Listing 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 问题背景。 某电子装配线在最终检验时靠目测判定电路板接收或拒收，且必须将拒收比例保持在 2% 或以下。 改进团队掌握了五套记录：二十五个连续批次的检验数与拒收数；一项由多名检验员依据商定的标准答案对同一批留存电路板进行判定的研究；这些检验员与标准答案判定不一致的项目的汇总表（按拒收类别分类）；在接收/拒收标准重写之后针对留存电路板进行的第二项研究；以及两台贴片头各自在一个时间段内的贴装数与拒收数。 要求智能体报告项目现状：接收/拒收判定是否可靠，在此之前必须具备什么条件，拒收比例在各批次间是否保持稳定，当前水平与要求相比如何，以及下一步应该做什么。 每一个报告的数字都必须来自智能体实际运行过的计算（具体指令见 Listing 3）。

paragraphs.en: Sequential decisions. The data steward releases one batch per request in the order fixed by the protocol: the tally only after the first study, the second study only after the tally, the lot record only after a study, the head counts only after the lots. Earlier results also determine the valid analysis at each stage: whether the first study passes decides whether the project goes to the lot record or to the tally and a second study; whether the second study passes decides whether the project continues or ends with an escalation; whether the lot chart is stable decides whether a capability index may be computed at all; whether the level is met decides whether a cause is sought. A complete walk is eight analyses over five phases, about ten steward exchanges, a dozen agent turns and a written report; on some data the correct walk is four analyses and a report that says why the rest was not done. The agent must carry diagnostic results forward to choose the correct route.
paragraphs.zh: 顺序决策。 数据管理员按照协议固定的顺序，每次请求发布一批数据：只有在第一次研究之后才发布计数结果，只有在计数结果之后才发布第二次研究，只有在某次研究之后才发布批次记录，只有在各批次之后才发布头数。 更早的结果也决定每个阶段的有效分析：第一次研究是否通过，决定项目是进入批次记录环节，还是进入计数结果和第二次研究；第二次研究是否通过，决定项目是继续进行，还是以一次升级告终；批次图是否稳定，决定是否根本可以计算过程能力指数；水平是否达标，决定是否需要寻找原因。 一次完整的走查是五个阶段上的八次分析，大约十次管理员交互、十几个智能体回合以及一份书面报告；在某些数据上，正确的走查是四次分析，外加一份说明其余分析为何未做的报告。 智能体必须将诊断结果向前传递，以选择正确的路线。

paragraphs.en: Case 33 is public and draws on a practitioner project (§ L ). Its graph (Figure 9 ) has eleven nodes, with the route determined by three computed values. Seed 2 is the long walk: the first inspector study fails, the rewritten criteria are proved, the lot record is stable, the reject share misses the requirement, one placement head is found to differ, and the project improves and moves to control. Seed 3 is the same case with different data: the rewritten criteria are not proved, and the correct project ends at its fourth analysis. We compare GPT-6-astra on both seeds (Table 13 ), including each turn, released batch, and reference and expert decision at each fork. The following sections give the case and verifier package, the same agent under permit-stop , and all agents on seed 3. We reproduce the complete plain seed-2 and permit-stop seed-3 reports.

paragraphs.en: On seed 2 the run follows the reference route: nine steward interactions, of which one provision (asking the plant for an agreement threshold) was refused as firewall and one request was unroutable until rephrased; eight analyses, every guard field reported within tolerance, all four forks right, and a five-section report that qualifies the inspection, states the stable-but-noncompliant level, names the outlying head and hands over a control plan (Listing 6 ). The decision at A_cap (step 6) depends on the verdicts at steps 2, 4 and 5. The report’s recommendation relies on step 8, whose execution requires a valid prerequisite verdict from the analysis at step 6.
paragraphs.zh: 在种子 2 上，本次运行遵循参考路线：九次智能体交互，其中一次供给请求（向智能体询问协议阈值）被防火墙拒绝，一次请求在改述前无法路由；八次分析，所有防护字段均在容差范围内报告，四个分叉全部正确，以及一份五部分报告，该报告对检查结果进行限定，说明稳定但不合规的等级，指出异常头部并提交一份控制方案（清单 6）。 A_cap（步骤 6）处的决策取决于步骤 2、4 和 5 的判定结果。 报告的建议依赖于步骤 8，其执行需要来自步骤 6 分析的有效前置判定结果。

paragraphs.en: Seed 3 begins with the same three analyses but produces different results: the rewritten criteria reach κ min = 0.5455 \kappa_{\min}=0.5455 , below the guard. The run states this (“the rewrite did not establish a reliable measurement system”), then requests the lot record and runs the p p chart, the capability index and two proportion tests that belong to the branch the study had closed. Both forks of seed 3 are graded; the second is scored incorrect via divergent evidence , reward 0.571 against 0.960 on seed 2: changing the second measurement verdict requires this agent to take a different route through the same case.
paragraphs.zh: 种子 3 从同样三项分析开始，但产生了不同结果：改写后的标准达到 κ min = 0.5455 \kappa_{\min}=0.5455，低于守门阈值。 该运行明确说明这一点（“改写未能建立一个可靠的测量系统”），随后请求批次记录，并运行 p p 图、过程能力指数和两次比例检验——这些本属于该研究已关闭的分支。 种子 3 的两个分叉都会被评分；第二个分叉通过分歧证据被判定为不正确，奖励为 0.571，而种子 2 为 0.960：要改变第二次测量的结论，该智能体必须在同一案例中走出一条不同的路线。

paragraphs.en: Table 14 is the seed-3 run turn by turn, in the agent’s own words: at turn 7 it writes “Rewritten criteria did not validate measurement … Declare measurement failure honestly; do not treat released data as proof of validity”, tries a declaration the case has no lock for, and in the same command requests the placement-head counts; at turn 8, “the failed validation remains the decisive project finding”, it computes the p p chart, the capability index and the two tests and plans to “label them non-certifying”. The agent describes the diagnostic correctly at each turn but then performs analyses that the diagnostic rules out. Table 15 is the seed-2 run in the same form, for comparison: the same opening, followed by analyses that the earlier diagnostic results on the reference route permit.

paragraphs.en: The contestant reads this and nothing else about the project:
paragraphs.zh: 参赛者仅阅读此内容，除此之外不了解项目的任何信息：

paragraphs.en: The source project measured visual-judgment agreement at κ = 0.44 \kappa=0.44 , rewrote the criteria and repeated the study at 1.00 1.00 . The case retains the requirement to validate the repair, while generating its own data. Rewriting the criteria establishes that they changed; a second study must establish whether they now work, and that study can fail. Every other measurement-system case in the corpus stops at a failed study. Case 33 tests the initial failure and whether the repair succeeds.
paragraphs.zh: 源项目测得视觉判断的一致性为 κ = 0.44 \kappa=0.44，随后重写了判定标准并重复研究，达到 1.00 1.00。 该案例保留了验证修复效果的要求，同时自行生成其数据。 重写标准只能证明标准发生了变化；必须进行第二次研究才能确认新标准是否有效，而该研究可能失败。 语料库中所有其他测量系统案例都止步于失败的研究。 案例 33 考察了最初的失败以及修复是否成功。

paragraphs.en: The steward holds six batches: the charter (define), the first study (study_1), the disagreement tally (disagreements, requires study_1), the second study (study_2, requires disagreements), the lot record (lots, requires either study), and the head-by-head counts (heads, requires lots). All six locks are order locks: the agreement criterion has no public form, so the lot record is released once a study exists, whatever its verdict. The contestant must use κ \kappa to decide whether lot charting is valid.
paragraphs.zh: 管理者持有六个批次：宪章（define）、第一次研究（study_1）、分歧统计（disagreements，要求 study_1）、第二次研究（study_2，要求 disagreements）、批次记录（lots，要求任一研究），以及逐一计数（heads，要求 lots）。 全部六个锁都是顺序锁：协议标准没有公开形式，因此只要存在一次研究就释放批次记录，无论其结论如何。 竞争者必须使用 κ \kappa 来判定批次绘制是否有效。

paragraphs.en: Table 18 lists the six tasks the case generates: the same graph, six data sets, four correct routes of three tiers, and one seed (3) on which the correct project ends after four analyses. The columns κ 1 \kappa_{1} and κ 2 \kappa_{2} give the minimum appraiser agreement in the first and second studies; the second study exists only when the first fails. OOC counts lots beyond the p p -chart limits, and p ¯ \bar{p} is the average reject share compared with the required 0.02. Seed 3 has one lot beyond the limits and a share below that requirement, but its failed measurement study makes those downstream calculations invalid.

paragraphs.en: This report illustrates the scoring limitation discussed in § 4.4 : the report labels the index “descriptive, not a capability certification.” The current schema counts the computation itself as a violation. paragraphs.en: We registered the design before any run, using seed 20260919. 1 1 1 The registered design is archived at docs/control_pairs_2026-09-19.json .
