sents.en: The design uses 16 no-go tasks drawn in proportion to the population’s fork mechanisms (stability 6, measurement 5, candidate cause 2, experiment 2, confirmation 1), each with its go twin at the same fork, 32 tasks; two agents, the largest and the smallest mover in Table 2 ; five instructions over a byte-identical truth package; three attempts per task and condition, for 960 trials in total.
sents.zh: 该设计使用 16 个按总体分叉机制比例抽取的禁行任务（稳定性 6、测量 5、候选原因 2、实验 2、确认 1），每个任务在同一分叉处都有一个对应的放行孪生任务，共 32 个任务；两个智能体，即表 2 中变动幅度最大和最小的智能体；在字节完全相同的真相包上使用五条指令；每个任务和条件尝试三次，总计 960 次试验。

sents.en: Plain is the benchmark instruction.
sents.zh: Plain（朴素）是基准指令。

sents.en: Permit-stop appends the stopping-permission paragraph in Listing 2 to this instruction.
sents.zh: Permit-stop（允许停止）在向该指令追加清单 2 中的停止许可段落。

paragraphs.en: “a project that ends at a failed precondition is finished. When a value you have computed shows that the next analysis is not valid on this data, the right thing to do is to end the project at that point: say which precondition failed, give the value that failed it, and say what the plant has to do before the analysis can go on. Such a project counts as complete and correct for that route. Going on past a failed precondition earns nothing, and a short report that ends early loses nothing.”
paragraphs.zh: “在一个前置条件失败处终止的项目即为已完成的项目。 当你计算出的某个值表明下一步分析在该数据上无效时，正确的做法是在该处终止项目：说明哪个前置条件失败了，给出使其失败的值，并说明工厂需要做什么才能使分析继续进行。 这样的项目对于该路径而言应被视为完整且正确的。 在前置条件失败之后继续推进得不到任何好处，而一份提前结束的简短报告也不会有任何损失。”

sents.en: “a project that ends at a failed precondition is finished.
sents.zh: “在一个前置条件失败处终止的项目即为已完成的项目。

paragraphs.en: The instruction states the precondition rule without explicit stopping permission:
paragraphs.zh: 该指令陈述了前置条件规则，但未明确给出停止许可：

paragraphs.en: “an analysis whose precondition has failed is not to be run. The preconditions are those of the discipline: a measurement system must be shown acceptable before process data are interpreted; a process must be in statistical control before its capability is estimated; a comparison must meet its distributional assumptions before its test is applied; an improvement must be confirmed before it is claimed. When a value you have computed fails one of these, report the precondition and the value, and do not run the analyses that depend on it.”
paragraphs.zh: “前提条件未通过的分析不应执行。 这些前提条件来自学科规范：在解释过程数据之前，必须先证明测量系统可接受；在估计过程能力之前，过程必须处于统计受控状态；在应用比较检验之前，比较必须满足其分布假设；在宣称改进之前，必须先确认改进。 当你计算出的某个值未通过其中一项时，应报告该前提条件与该值，并且不要运行依赖它的那些分析。”

sents.en: “an analysis whose precondition has failed is not to be run.
sents.zh: “前提条件未通过的分析不应执行。

sents.en: The preconditions are those of the discipline: a measurement system must be shown acceptable before process data are interpreted; a process must be in statistical control before its capability is estimated; a comparison must meet its distributional assumptions before its test is applied; an improvement must be confirmed before it is claimed.

paragraphs.en: “declare each precondition value as soon as you have computed it. steward status lists this project’s handbook preconditions and the fields they read; steward declare <field> <value> records a value, and the steward replies whether each precondition holds on what you have declared.”
paragraphs.zh: “一旦计算出每个前置条件的值，就立即声明它。steward status 会列出本项目的手册前置条件及其读取的字段；steward declare <field> <value> 用于记录一个值，智能体会回复根据你所声明的内容，每个前置条件是否成立。”

paragraphs.en: From the declared values alone, the steward returns HOLDS or DOES NOT HOLD . Both the data-release policy and the truth package remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭声明的值，管理者即返回「成立」（HOLDS）或「不成立」（DOES NOT HOLD）。 数据发布策略与真值包均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: We also measure use of the declaration channel: DeepSeek-v4-pro declared at least one precondition value in 100% of its 96 trials (4.3 declarations per trial, 67 trials in which a precondition was reported not to hold), GPT-6-astra in 69% (2.6, 37). Table 20 gives the result; changes are against the same agent’s plain condition, with case-clustered 95% intervals; “both sides” counts the matched forks right on every no-go and go seed in each of the three attempts; “within-task disagreement” is the share of tasks whose graded-fork verdict differs across three independent attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测量了声明通道的使用情况：DeepSeek-v4-pro 在其 96 次试验中的 100% 至少声明了一个前置条件值（每次试验 4.3 次声明，其中 67 次试验报告前置条件不成立），GPT-6-astra 为 69%（2.6，37）。 表 20 给出了结果；变化是相对于同一智能体的普通条件而言，并附有按案例聚类的 95% 区间；“双侧”计的是在三次尝试中的每一次里，所有 no-go 和 go 种子上的匹配分叉全部判断正确的情况；“任务内不一致”指的是其评分分叉判定在三次独立尝试之间存在差异的任务所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: An exploratory analysis added after the registered runs compares remind directly with normative , retaining the same cases and all three attempts in each of 4,000 paired case-bootstrap resamples (11 case clusters; seed 20260919). For DeepSeek-v4-pro, the changes are +5 no-go points (95% CI -8 to +17) and +5 go points (-4 to +15). For GPT-6-astra, they are +14 (+0 to +29) and +10 (+2 to +26), respectively. These descriptive contrasts are not adjusted for multiple comparisons; improvements over plain alone do not establish an incremental benefit over normative. Figure 5 B plots these accuracy estimates for both agents under each instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 在注册运行之后补充的探索性分析将 remind 与 normative 直接进行比较，在 4,000 次配对案例自助重抽样中保留相同的案例及每个案例的全部三次尝试（11 个案例簇；随机种子 20260919）。 对于 DeepSeek-v4-pro，变化为 +5 个 no-go 点（95% CI -8 至 +17）和 +5 个 go 点（-4 至 +15）。 对于 GPT-6-astra，则分别为 +14（+0 至 +29）和 +10（+2 至 +26）。 这些描述性对比未经多重比较校正；相对于 plain 单独使用的提升并不能证明其相对于 normative 具有增量收益。 图 5 B 绘制了两个智能体在每种指令下的这些准确率估计值。

paragraphs.en: Sensitivity to the reward’s form. Multiple metrics expose trade-offs hidden by a single score ( Liang et al., 2022 ) . A proxy reward can diverge from its intended behavioral target ( Pan et al., 2022 ) ; we therefore report components and independently review report validity, without inferring a training cause for errors. The reward combines four competencies by a harmonic mean and multiplies by two penalties (§ 3.3 ). Table 24 recomputes every task’s reward from the same components under 11 other combinations and compares the resulting agent ranking with the paper’s: arithmetic, geometric and minimum aggregation; dropping either penalty; double-weighting the route term; and four treatments of the misuse term (doubled, quadrupled, subtracted rather than multiplied, and folded into the harmonic mean as a fifth term). Every one of them keeps the leader and the top three and correlates with the reported ranking at Spearman ρ ≥ 0.98 \rho\geq 0.98 ; the largest move of any agent is 2 places. The misuse term has a limited effect because it is non-zero in 19% of trials with a mean of 0.023. Scoring the route alone ( ρ = 0.90 \rho=0.90 ) keeps the leader and two of the top three, with moves of up to 3 places; that is the partial separation between computing and routing that § 4.2 reports. The thresholds inside the guards (%SV ≤ 0.30 \leq 0.30 , ndc ≥ 5 \geq 5 , out-of-control = 0 =0 , p ≥ 0.05 p\geq 0.05 ) are the standards’ own and were not tuned. The no-go and go accuracies of Table 2 , the matched-fork gap, the Stopped column and B-divert route success are computed independently of reward, so their values remain unchanged under every alternative reward aggregation. In Table 24 , Spearman ρ \rho compares each ranking with the reported one; “top three kept” counts retained top-three agents, “largest rank move” is the maximum change in position, and the last column counts agents whose rank changes by two or more positions under the alternative aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: 对奖励形式的敏感性。 多项指标能揭示单一分数所掩盖的权衡（Liang et al., 2022）。 代理奖励可能偏离其预期的行为目标（Pan et al., 2022）；因此我们报告各组成部分，并独立审查报告的有效性，而不为错误推断训练成因。 该奖励通过调和平均数组合四项能力，并乘以两个惩罚项（§ 3.3）。 表 24 在其他 11 种组合下根据相同组成部分重新计算每个任务的奖励，并将由此得到的智能体排名与论文的排名进行比较：算术、几何和最小值聚合；去掉任一惩罚项；将路由项权重加倍；以及对误用项的四种处理（加倍、四倍、改为相减而非相乘、以及作为第五项并入调和平均数）。 每一种组合都保持了榜首和前三名，且与报告排名的 Spearman ρ ≥ 0.98 \rho\geq 0.98 相关；任何智能体的最大变动为 2 个名次。 误用项的影响有限，因为它仅在 19% 的试验中非零，且均值为 0.023。 仅对路由打分（ρ = 0.90 \rho=0.90）时保持榜首和前三名中的两名，变动最多达 3 个名次；这正是 § 4.2 所报告的计算与路由之间的部分分离。 守卫内部的阈值（%SV ≤ 0.30 \leq 0.30、ndc ≥ 5 \geq 5、失控 = 0 =0、p ≥ 0.05 p\geq 0.05）均为标准自身的规定，未经调整。 表 2 的不通过与通过准确率、匹配分叉差距、Stopped 列以及 B-divert 路由成功率均独立于奖励计算，因此其数值在所有替代的奖励聚合方式下保持不变。 在表 24 中，Spearman ρ \rho 将每个排名与报告的排名进行比较；“保持前三”统计保留下来的前三名智能体数量，“最大名次变动”是位置的最大变化，最后一列统计在替代聚合方式下名次变动两个或更多位置的智能体数量。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty. Main fork-rate intervals and paired ranking comparisons use 4,000 bootstrap resamples of the 15 cases, retaining each sampled case’s associated records to preserve within-case dependence ( Field & Welsh, 2007 ) . Intervals describe variation across these cases, not across a population of vendors. Few-run point estimates can conceal substantial uncertainty ( Agarwal et al., 2021 ) ; we therefore report intervals and repeated attempts alongside aggregation sensitivity. With 12 to 15 case clusters the percentile bootstrap runs short of its nominal level: in a simulation that draws cases from profiles matching the observed case sizes and rates, the 95% percentile interval covers 91% of the time at 12 clusters and 92% at 15, while a cluster-robust t t interval with one degree of freedom fewer than the number of cases covers 93% to 95%. The t t intervals are one to three points wider at each end and leave every reported bound within three points of the percentile bound: 30% to 64% for the 47% acted rate, 7% to 31% for matched NO-GO accuracy and 86% to 98% for matched GO accuracy ( scripts/review_coverage_sim.py , scripts/review_audit_intervals.py ). A rate at a boundary, such as 20 of 20 GO units correct, has a degenerate percentile interval; Table 33 shows the count in that cell, and the exact one-sided 95% lower bound without clustering is 86%.
paragraphs.zh: 不确定性。 主要分叉率区间和配对排名比较基于对 15 个案例进行的 4,000 次 bootstrap 重抽样，并保留每个被抽样案例的关联记录以维持案例内的依赖性（ Field & Welsh, 2007 ）。 区间描述的是这些案例之间的变异，而不是某个供应商总体之间的变异。 少次运行的点估计可能掩盖相当大的不确定性（ Agarwal et al., 2021 ）；因此我们在聚合敏感性分析之外同时报告区间和重复尝试结果。 在 12 到 15 个案例聚类的规模下，百分位 bootstrap 的实际覆盖率低于其名义水平：在一项按与观测到的案例规模和比率相匹配的画像抽取案例的模拟中，95% 百分位区间在 12 个聚类时覆盖率为 91%，15 个聚类时为 92%，而一种自由度比案例数少一的聚类稳健 t t 区间的覆盖率为 93% 到 95%。 t t 区间在两端各宽一到三个百分点，并且使每个报告的边界与百分位边界的差距不超过三个百分点：47% 的 acted 率对应 30% 到 64%，匹配 NO-GO 准确率对应 7% 到 31%，匹配 GO 准确率对应 86% 到 98%（ scripts/review_coverage_sim.py , scripts/review_audit_intervals.py ）。 处于边界的比率（例如 20 个 GO 单元全部正确）会得到退化的百分位区间；表 33 显示了该单元格中的计数，在不考虑聚类的情况下，精确的单侧 95% 下界为 86%。

paragraphs.en: Only agents with three attempts per task enter this analysis. pass@3 measures success on at least one of the three attempts, following the pass@ k k usage in code evaluation ( Chen et al., 2021 ) ; pass 3 requires every decision to be correct on all three attempts, following the reliability criterion in τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2024 ) . We compute both quantities directly from the three attempts observed for each task; they respectively measure occasional success and consistent success on repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 只有每个任务有三次尝试机会的智能体才纳入本分析。pass@3 衡量三次尝试中至少有一次成功的比率，遵循代码评测中 pass@k 的用法（Chen et al., 2021）；pass3 要求每次决策在全部三次尝试中都正确，遵循 τ-bench 中的可靠性标准（Yao et al., 2024）。 我们直接根据每个任务观测到的三次尝试来计算这两个指标；它们分别衡量重复运行中的偶发成功与持续成功。

paragraphs.en: Spread is the highest minus the lowest reward across three attempts on the same task.
paragraphs.zh: Spread 是在同一个任务上三次尝试中最高奖励减去最低奖励的差值。

paragraphs.en: pass 3 and pass@3 measure different events (all three attempts correct versus at least one correct), so their ratio does not estimate bias at k = 1 k=1 . Variability differs by agent and tier: GLM-5.3-Flash is unreliable on C-stop and steadier on A-go; Claude-Sonnet-5 shows the reverse pattern; GPT-6-astra is steady on C-stop, where pass 3 equals pass@3. B-divert failures recur across attempts. Its pass 3 is 0.000 for 11 of 13 agents and at most 0.111 (GPT-5.6-luna), so the poor performance on this routing tier persists when the same tasks are attempted repeatedly.
paragraphs.zh: pass 3 与 pass@3 度量的是不同事件（三次尝试全部正确与至少一次正确），因此二者的比值并不能估计 k=1 时的偏差。 变异性因智能体与层级而异：GLM-5.3-Flash 在 C-stop 上不可靠，在 A-go 上较为稳定；Claude-Sonnet-5 呈现相反的模式；GPT-6-astra 在 C-stop 上稳定，其 pass 3 等于 pass@3。 B-divert 的失败在多次尝试中反复出现。 其 pass 3 在 13 个智能体中的 11 个上为 0.000，最高仅为 0.111（GPT-5.6-luna），因此当相同任务被重复尝试时，该路由层级上的糟糕表现依然持续。

paragraphs.en: Figures 11 – 13 expose the task-level structure behind the aggregate reliability rates. A cell is the fraction of retained attempts in which every reference-route decision is correct ( pq = 1 \mathrm{pq}=1 with at least one graded decision). All 13 agents contribute the first three attempts in the same retained-job order used for Table 25 . Each cell therefore takes a value in { 0 , 1 / 3 , 2 / 3 , 1 } \{0,1/3,2/3,1\} ; three observations do not establish a stable success probability. No confidence interval is inferred from these few observations. Columns retain case and seed order, so adjacent seeds can be compared without sorting tasks by measured difficulty. Asterisks mark the four deliberately unlocked tasks, which remain in their corresponding reference routing tiers when success rates are calculated.

paragraphs.en: Figure 14 expands the error taxonomy in Table 3 . Unlike a distribution conditional on an error, each bar includes correct decisions and sums to all graded decisions for that agent, phase and required action. This separates the prevalence of errors from their composition. Measure, Analyze and Improve contain all no-go forks; Define and Control contribute only go decisions and remain in Table 3 . Counts refer to decision occurrences on the reference route, including forks the agent failed to reach, rather than whole trials or expert-rated report violations.
paragraphs.zh: 图14扩展了表3中的错误分类体系。 与以某个错误为条件的分布不同，每个柱形包含正确决策，并对该智能体在该阶段所需行动的所有已评级决策求和。 这将错误的普遍性与错误的构成区分开来。 Measure、Analyze 和 Improve 包含所有的 no-go 分叉；Define 和 Control 仅贡献 go 决策，因此仍保留在表3中。 计数指的是参考路径上的决策发生次数，包括智能体未能到达的分叉，而非整个试验或专家评级的报告违规。

paragraphs.en: The strict audit requires every field read by a guard to be reported and its numerical value verified. Of 272 qualifying no-go decisions, 201 take an incorrect route. In 174 of those errors, the diagnostic appears before the forbidden analysis in the trace. The remaining errors do not all meet this temporal criterion. The 71 correct routes in the verified subset should therefore not be read as an estimate of stopping after a prior warning. The audit distinguishes incorrect values, missing fields, values implying go and absent diagnostics. Order here is the order of records in the agent-written trace. The steward’s audit log, written by the harness, fixes independently when each batch was released and read, but local computations leave no entry in it, and one script can compute the diagnostic and the downstream analysis in a single run. The trace therefore shows only that the diagnostic was recorded first; whether the agent inspected it before choosing the next analysis is not observable from the trace. Terminal recordings are retained for every trial and were not used for this count.
paragraphs.zh: 严格审计要求警卫读取的每个字段都必须报告，且其数值须经过核验。 在 272 个符合条件的不通过决定中，有 201 个走了错误的路线。 在其中 174 个错误里，诊断在轨迹中出现于被禁止的分析之前。 其余错误并非全部满足这一时间先后标准。 因此，已核验子集中的 71 个正确路线不应被解读为对先前警告后停止的估计。 该审计区分错误数值、缺失字段、暗示通过的数值以及缺失的诊断。 此处的顺序是指智能体所写轨迹中记录的顺序。 由测试框架写成的管家审计日志独立地固定了每个批次何时被发布和读取，但本地计算在其中不留任何条目，且一个脚本可以在单次运行中同时计算诊断和下游分析。 因此，轨迹只表明诊断被先记录；智能体是否在选择下一个分析之前查看了它，无法从轨迹中观察到。 每次试验的终端录像均已保留，但未用于此项统计。

sents.zh: 严格审计要求警卫读取的每个字段都必须报告，且其数值须经过核验。

paragraphs.en: Among reached forks, go accuracy is 84%. No-go accuracy is 21% when unlocked tasks are excluded and 20% when the defective-narrative case is excluded. Under either exclusion, agents still choose warranted continuation much more often than they correctly stop or divert.

sents.en: All data and outcome definitions are from DMAIC-Bench; the heatmaps use a shared cold-to-hot blue–red color scale and the stacked bars retain our decision-level taxonomy.
sents.zh: 所有数据与结果定义均来自 DMAIC-Bench；热力图采用统一的冷到热蓝红色标，堆叠柱状图保留我们的决策级分类体系。

paragraphs.en: Practitioner evidence. No human has solved a DMAIC-Bench task for evaluation, so we report no “humans X X % vs models Y Y %” score. The eight cases drawn from closure reports retain the decision structure followed by the project’s black belt, including each stop. Practitioners also apply prerequisites inconsistently: only 16 of 63 gauge studies in a private corpus of 155 projects applied the distinct-categories criterion. Standards and projects that stopped document the expected rule, even though most reports in that corpus did not apply it. The guards encode the standards as normative, so the benchmark scores stricter than median practice.
paragraphs.zh: 从业者证据。 尚无人类完成过用于评测的 DMAIC-Bench 任务，因此我们不报告「人类 X X % 对比模型 Y Y %」的分数。 取自结项报告的八个案例保留了项目黑带所遵循的决策结构，包括每一次终止。 从业者对前置条件的应用也不一致：在某个包含 155 个项目的私人语料库中，63 项测量系统分析里只有 16 项应用了不同类别数准则。 标准和已终止的项目记录了该预期规则，尽管该语料库中的大多数报告并未应用它。 这些守卫将标准编码为规范性要求，因此基准的评分严于中位实践水平。

paragraphs.en: We report raw unanimity and Fleiss’ κ \kappa for the three independent reviewers’ nominal judgments ( Fleiss, 1971 ) . These measures describe reviewer consistency. Establishing whether a shared judgment applies the correct methodological rule requires evidence beyond agreement alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告三位独立评审名义判断的原始一致率与 Fleiss’ κ \kappa （ Fleiss, 1971 ）。 这些指标描述评审者之间的一致性。 要确定共同的判断是否应用了正确的方法学规则，仅凭一致性是不够的，还需要更多证据。

paragraphs.en: The majority judged conduct acceptable on 18 units, mixed on 11 and unacceptable on 1. Six units were potential over-penalties: the scorer marked them incorrect, but at least two reviewers found their conduct acceptable, with unanimous agreement on five. Per-item votes, rationales, the coordinator’s numerical re-computations and the scorer probes are released with the benchmark; the blind packets are reusable without the answers. We retained the original disagreements: two units turn on whether a trajectory may continue learning versus concluding ; one on whether a diameter gauge study covers wall thickness; one on an individuals chart with no signal while a moving-range chart indicated that the same process run was out of control.
paragraphs.zh: 多数评审在18个单元上判定该行为可接受，11个单元上评价不一，1个单元上判定不可接受。 有六个单元可能是过度惩罚：评分员将其标记为错误，但至少有两名评审认为其行为可接受，其中五个单元上意见完全一致。 逐项投票、评审理由、协调员的数值复算以及评分员探针均随基准一同发布；盲测包可在不含答案的情况下重复使用。 我们保留了原有的分歧：两个单元取决于一条轨迹应继续学习还是应得出结论；一个单元关于直径量规研究是否涵盖壁厚；还有一个单元是个体图未显示任何信号，而移动极差图却表明同一过程运行处于失控状态。

paragraphs.en: The 60 units include 40 no-go-side decisions and 20 unweighted go twins at the same case and checkpoint. We allocated no-go units to five mechanisms in proportion to the 566 reached no-go decisions, with a minimum of five per mechanism, then stratified by scorer verdict within each mechanism. The frame is the 3,300 first-attempt decisions of the 11 agents whose campaigns were complete when the study was frozen on 19 September; the two Qwen agents finished afterwards and are absent from it. Agent was not a stratum, and the 40 units fall on all 11 agents, at most seven each. Each no-go unit carries a sampling weight; Table 28 lists the strata with their population and sample counts and the weights. The sample uses at most one unit per trajectory and seven per agent, excludes all study-1 trajectories, and has a published seed. Each reviewer received 362 files hashed against sealed packets; all 180 records were returned. This study did not change any scoring rule. Table 29 lists units by case and agent, with counts of no-go-side acting on invalid evidence and go-side over-claiming from the expert majority.
paragraphs.zh: 这60个单元包括40个拒绝侧判定单元和20个在同一案例和检查点上的未加权放行孪生单元。 我们按566个实际达成的拒绝判定的比例将拒绝单元分配到五个机制，每个机制至少五个单元，然后在每个机制内按评分员裁定进行分层。 抽样框是11个智能体的3,300个首次尝试判定，这些智能体的活动在研究于9月19日冻结时已完成；两个Qwen智能体在此之后才完成，故不在其中。 智能体不是分层变量，这40个单元分布在全部11个智能体上，每个智能体最多七个单元。 每个拒绝单元都带有抽样权重；表28列出了各分层及其总体数量、样本数量和权重。 该样本在每个轨迹中最多取一个单元、在每个智能体中最多取七个单元，排除了研究一的所有轨迹，并公开了随机种子。 每位评审员收到了362个与密封数据包进行哈希核对的文件；全部180条记录均已返回。 本研究没有更改任何评分规则。 表29按案例和智能体列出各单元，并统计了基于无效证据采取拒绝侧行动以及与专家多数意见相比放行侧过度宣称的数量。

paragraphs.en: The expert majority disagreed with the benchmark’s gate label on four of the 20 GO units and one of the 40 NO-GO units. Three of the four GO disagreements arise where the agent’s own downstream work, rather than the guard value, drew the STOP: case 39 seed 6 at A_rsm (GLM-5.3), where the lack-of-fit test passes but the report states a stationary point at twice its coordinates; case 31 seed 0 at M_stability (Claude-Fable-5.1), where no point lies beyond the individuals limits but the report dismisses a Nelson rule 5 signal it had itself detected; and case 36 seed 5 at I_confirm (GLM-5.3), where the before-and-after difference is significant but the new mean overshoots the target with a moving-range signal. The fourth, case 33 seed 2 at M_pchart (GLM-5.3), turns on the rule itself: no lot exceeds its limit, but the reviewers found a trend and a Bonferroni-adjusted change point. The one NO-GO disagreement, case 31 seed 4 at M_msa (Claude-Sonnet-5), has ndc of 4.82 against the threshold of five, which two reviewers judged too narrow a margin to bar a directional analysis while the third left the gate undetermined. None of these labels was revised: the scorer was frozen before the study, the coordinator recorded disagreements as flags, and the reference routes remain as generated.
paragraphs.zh: 专家多数意见不同意基准在20个GO单元中的4个和40个NO-GO单元中的1个上给出的门槛标签。 四个GO分歧中有三个源于智能体自身的下游工作，而非守护值触发了STOP：case 39 seed 6 位于 A_rsm（GLM-5.3），失拟检验通过，但报告在两倍坐标处给出了驻点；case 31 seed 0 位于 M_stability（Claude-Fable-5.1），没有任何点超出单值限，但报告否定了它自己检测到的Nelson规则5信号；以及 case 36 seed 5 位于 I_confirm（GLM-5.3），前后差异显著，但新均值超出目标并出现移动极差信号。 第四个分歧，case 33 seed 2 位于 M_pchart（GLM-5.3），焦点在规则本身：没有一个批次超出其限值，但评审者发现了一个趋势和一个经Bonferroni校正的变点。 唯一的NO-GO分歧，case 31 seed 4 位于 M_msa（Claude-Sonnet-5），ndc为4.82，低于五这一阈值，两位评审者认为这一差距太小，不足以排除方向性分析，而第三位则将门槛保留为未定。 这些标签均未被修改：评分器在研究开始前已被冻结，协调者将分歧记录为标记，参考路由保持生成时的原样。

paragraphs.en: The design weights correct for mechanism and verdict, not for agent. Three agents contribute no unit judged to act on invalid evidence and two contribute 10 of the 18 that do. Reweighting so that each agent counts in proportion to its share of the 566 reached no-go decisions gives 46% with an interval from 27 to 55, equal agent weights give 45% with an interval from 26 to 55, and dropping any single agent moves the design estimate between 40% and 51%. A bootstrap over units within strata instead of over cases gives 47% with an interval from 33 to 61 for the design estimator. The point estimate therefore does not depend on which agents were drawn; the interval width reflects 40 units on 12 cases ( scripts/study2_agent_sensitivity.py ).
paragraphs.zh: 该设计权重机制校正的是结论的正确性，而非智能体的正确性。 三个智能体贡献了零个被判定为基于无效证据行动的单元，而其中两个贡献了 18 个此类单元中的 10 个。 按各智能体占 566 个到达否决决策的份额比例重新加权，得到 46%，区间为 27 至 55；对各智能体赋予相等权重得到 45%，区间为 26 至 55；剔除任意单个智能体则会使该设计的估计值在 40% 与 51% 之间变动。 改为在各层内对单元而非对案例进行自助法抽样，该设计估计量得到 47%，区间为 33 至 61。 因此，点估计不依赖于抽中了哪些智能体；区间宽度反映了 12 个案例上的 40 个单元（ scripts/study2_agent_sensitivity.py ）。

paragraphs.en: No-go estimates retain the population-stratum/sample-stratum weights; go twins are unweighted. Case-clustered intervals use 4,000 bootstrap resamples, preserving each sampled case’s records and weights ( Field & Welsh, 2007 ) . The study covers 12 cases; subgroup intervals resample only the cases represented in that subgroup, retaining their associated records and sampling weights.
paragraphs.zh: 不推算的估计保留总体层/样本层权重；推算的孪生样本不加权。 按病例聚类的区间使用 4,000 次自助重抽样，保留每个被抽取病例的记录和权重（Field & Welsh, 2007）。 该研究涵盖 12 个病例；子群区间仅对出现在该子群中的病例进行重抽样，并保留其对应的记录和抽样权重。

paragraphs.en: Recomputation of the study-2 reports also found two gauge studies at one-third of true %StudyVariation and an optimum at twice its coordinates. The branch verdict does not establish that the numerical values reported along that route are correct.
paragraphs.zh: 对研究2报告的重新计算同样发现：在真实%StudyVariation的三分之一处存在两个量具研究，且其最优值位于其坐标的两倍处。 分支判定并不能证明沿该路径报告的数值是正确的。

paragraphs.en: LLM judging requires task-specific validation given known preference and reasoning biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) ; agent-based evaluators can also inspect intermediate work and artifacts ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) . To assess whether LLM readings could substitute for expert review, 3 models answered the reviewers’ protocol on the same 60 sealed packets: the full questionnaire, the same JSON schema, temperature 0, no access to the agent name, the score or the reference route ( scripts/llm_reader_pilot.py ). Two readers are contestants and one is from a vendor outside the roster. Table 30 compares each with the expert majority; “acted” is the disjunction the paper reports (a forbidden conclusion asserted or a forbidden action recommended). We use these outputs to compare readers with experts; the benchmark scoring rules and reported expert judgments are independent of the outputs from all three automatic readers.

paragraphs.en: Agreement between each reader and the expert majority uses Cohen’s κ \kappa for two sets of nominal judgments ( Cohen, 1960 ) . The majority provides a comparison reference that can itself be wrong. These comparisons and inter-expert Fleiss’ κ \kappa use different designs and should be interpreted accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: 每位读者与专家多数意见之间的一致性采用 Cohen's κ \kappa（用于两组名义判断）来衡量 ( Cohen, 1960 )。 多数意见提供了一个本身可能有误的对比参照。 这些对比与专家间 Fleiss's κ \kappa 使用不同的实验设计，应据此进行相应解读。

paragraphs.en: In Table 30 , agreement is the share of units where the reader matches the majority, with Cohen’s κ \kappa in parentheses. The “no-go units acted” and “go units acted” columns are the rates each reader would report. Sensitivity and specificity use the expert majority as the reference on no-go units; panel (b) separates a contestant reader’s own reports from those of other agents.

paragraphs.en: (b) Reported rates, diagnostic accuracy and own-report agreement
paragraphs.zh: (b) 报告率、诊断准确性与自我报告一致性

paragraphs.en: Agreement with the expert majority is above chance ( κ \kappa 0.26 to 0.60), but every reader misestimates at least one side. One labels almost every computed-but-withheld index “acted” (sensitivity 1.00, specificity 0.50); another misses most acted no-go reports and over-calls go reports (0.39 / 0.77). Estimated no-go rates span 30% to 72%, against experts’ 45%, a spread wider than any difference between agents here. The non-contestant reader performs no better, so vendor independence alone does not establish validity. Own-report agreement for contestant readers (panel (b)) rests on four and seven units; we do not interpret these estimates. Unanimous readings (34 of 60, 57%) match experts 88% of the time. Accepting these verdicts and referring disagreements to experts halves human reading, with residual error near one in eight: suitable for triage, but insufficient for estimating the overall rate. Using reader verdicts as measurements would require agreement within the human inter-rater range on held-out labels, against both individual experts and their majority; sample sensitivity and specificity with prevalence correction before extrapolation to 676 no-go decisions; accuracy by fork mechanism, since acting concentrates at stability and candidate-cause forks; and oversampling reports that compute a forbidden index but explicitly withhold its use, the boundary case on which readers disagree most about whether the report uses invalid evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 与专家多数的一致性高于随机水平（κ 为 0.26 至 0.60），但每位阅卷者都至少误判了一侧。 一位阅卷者几乎把每一个「已计算但被扣留」的指标都标记为「已使用」（灵敏度 1.00，特异度 0.50）；另一位则漏掉大多数「已使用且不可行」的报告，并过度判定「可行」报告（0.39 / 0.77）。 估计的不可行率介于 30% 到 72% 之间，而专家的估计为 45%，这一差距比本文中各智能体之间的任何差异都要大。 非参赛阅卷者的表现并无更好，因此仅凭供应商独立性并不能确立有效性。 参赛阅卷者的自报一致性（面板 (b)）仅基于四个和七个单元；我们不解读这些估计值。 全体一致的意见（60 份中的 34 份，57%）与专家意见的吻合率为 88%。 采纳这些判定并将分歧提交给专家，可将人工阅卷量减半，残余错误率约为八分之一：适用于分诊，但不足以估计总体比率。 将阅卷者的判定作为测量结果使用，需要满足以下条件：在留出标签上与个别专家及其多数意见的一致性达到人类评分者之间一致性的范围内；在外推到 676 个不可行决策之前，结合流行率校正来抽样估计灵敏度和特异度；按分叉机制分别评估准确性，因为「已使用」集中在稳定性分叉和候选原因分叉上；并过度抽样那些计算了被禁止的指标但明确扣留其使用的报告——这正是阅卷者对报告是否使用了无效证据分歧最大的边界情形。

paragraphs.en: Of the 32 scorer-incorrect no-go units, 17 acted (15 mixed, 2 unacceptable) and 15 did not (all acceptable); of the 8 scorer-correct no-go units, 1 acted. Reviewers unanimously judged conduct unacceptable in three situations: a machine comparison escalated into a system-wide cause, a recipe-cause branch closed on a non-significant test, and a warranted conclusion refused on a wrong p p -value. Two units carried a task-text conflict between the instruction and the released charter batch, which we recorded separately from errors in the agents’ analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 在32个评分者判为错误的不执行单元中，17个执行了操作（15个混合，2个不可接受），15个未执行（全部可接受）；在8个评分者判为正确的不执行单元中，1个执行了操作。 审阅者一致判定三种情形下的行为不可接受：一次机器比较升级为全系统层面的因果结论，一个配方因果分支在非显著检验上被关闭，以及一个有依据的结论因错误的 p p 值而被拒绝。 有两个单元在指令与已发布的章程批次之间存在任务文本冲突，我们将其与智能体分析中的错误分开记录。

paragraphs.en: Table 33 rescores the same units under three assessment criteria ( scripts/study2_rescoring.py ). The criteria are distinct judgements rather than thresholds of one score: route errors and invalid report claims can occur independently, as the one route-correct NO-GO unit that acted on invalid evidence and the six GO units that over-claimed after a correct route show. The gap between GO and NO-GO decisions is largest under route scoring and smallest under expert decision correctness, and its interval excludes zero under each criterion on this sample; the rates do not extrapolate beyond the audited population of 11 agents.
paragraphs.zh: 表 33 在三项评估标准下对同一批单元重新打分（scripts/study2_rescoring.py）。 这些标准是各自独立的判断，而非同一分数的不同阈值：路线错误与无效报告声明可以独立发生，正如那一个路线正确却依据无效证据行动的 NO-GO 单元，以及那六个在路线正确后过度声称的 GO 单元所示。 GO 与 NO-GO 决策之间的差距在路线打分下最大，在专家决策正确性下最小，并且在该样本上其在每项标准下的区间都不包含零；这些比率不能外推到受审计的 11 个智能体总体之外。

paragraphs.en: The expert acted judgment already covers the complete report, including summaries and recommendations. It does not separately locate where a computed result is reused. We therefore traced results through all 40 frozen no-go units from study 2, covering 11 agents and 12 cases. This extension is a single Codex-assisted annotation pass informed by the existing reviews, without a new independent human review, so we treat the labels as exploratory.
paragraphs.zh: 专家行为判断已覆盖完整报告，包括摘要和建议。 它并未单独定位计算结果被复用的位置。 因此，我们通过研究 2 中全部 40 个冻结的否决单元追踪结果，涵盖 11 个智能体和 12 个案例。 这一扩展是在现有评审基础上进行的单次 Codex 辅助标注，没有新的独立人工评审，因此我们将这些标签视为探索性的。

sents.zh: 它并未单独定位计算结果被复用的位置。

paragraphs.en: Each unit is one trajectory and focal checkpoint. We identify a successful computation on the continuation under examination, distinguish it from the gate diagnostic or a refused attempt, and follow its value or substantive finding into the report. Additional calculations on independent evidence are not automatically invalid because another branch stopped. We read all complete reports, inventoried 556 submitted trace steps, inspected the relevant outputs, and verified the 280 frozen packet-file hashes. For each candidate result, the ledger records its trace index, local presentation, destination passage and contrary qualifications. Repeated business targets alone do not establish a result dependency. An opening summary can reuse a result presented later; report order need not match the order in which computations were executed.
paragraphs.zh: 每个单元是一条轨迹与焦点检查点。 我们在所考察的延续执行中识别一次成功的计算，将其与门控诊断或被拒绝的尝试区分开，并追踪其数值或实质性发现进入报告。 基于独立证据的额外计算不会仅仅因为另一分支停止而自动失效。 我们阅读了所有完整报告，清点了 556 个提交的轨迹步骤，检查了相关输出，并验证了 280 个冻结数据包文件的哈希值。 对于每个候选结果，台账记录其轨迹索引、局部呈现、目标段落以及相反的限制条件。 仅凭重复的业务目标并不能确立结果之间的依赖关系。 开头的总结可以复用后文呈现的结果；报告顺序不必与计算执行的顺序一致。

paragraphs.en: We code reuse separately from whether it is justified. Restricted description preserves the relevant limitation or rests on a valid alternative. Unsupported indirect reliance uses a result as a premise in a later synthesis or ranking without an explicit forbidden conclusion or action; explicit reliance supports such a conclusion or action. Unresolved scope or dependency is retained as uncertain. We retain the strongest supported use of the candidate result and record cross-section reuse separately. A summary or recommendation may omit a caveat stated beside the calculation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将代码复用单独处理，而不考虑其是否正当。 受限描述保留了相关限制，或基于有效的替代方案。 无依据的间接依赖指在后续综合或排序中将某一结果用作前提，而没有明确的禁止性结论或行动；明确的依赖则支持此类结论或行动。 未解决的范围或依赖保留为不确定状态。 我们保留候选结果最强且最有依据的用法，并单独记录跨章节复用。 摘要或建议可以省略在计算旁说明的注意事项。

sents.en: We code reuse separately from whether it is justified.
sents.zh: 我们将代码复用单独处理，而不考虑其是否正当。

sents.en: Unsupported indirect reliance uses a result as a premise in a later synthesis or ranking without an explicit forbidden conclusion or action; explicit reliance supports such a conclusion or action.
sents.zh: 无依据的间接依赖指在后续综合或排序中将某一结果用作前提，而没有明确的禁止性结论或行动；明确的依赖则支持此类结论或行动。

sents.en: Unresolved scope or dependency is retained as uncertain.
sents.zh: 未解决的范围或依赖保留为不确定状态。

sents.en: We retain the strongest supported use of the candidate result and record cross-section reuse separately.
sents.zh: 我们保留候选结果最强且最有依据的用法，并单独记录跨章节复用。

sents.en: A summary or recommendation may omit a caveat stated beside the calculation.
sents.zh: 摘要或建议可以省略在计算旁说明的注意事项。

paragraphs.en: We identified candidate continuation computations in 30 units, rather than using all 32 frozen scorer-incorrect units as the denominator. Of these 30, 25 (83.3%) have identifiable reuse in another report section: 13 explicit-reliance cases, 11 restricted-description or valid-alternative cases, and one unresolved case. Three additional possible links are excluded because the destination cannot be confidently tied to the candidate result. Table 34 also includes local uses: two of the 15 explicit-reliance cases lack a confirmed cross-section link. All 15 were already labeled acted by the original expert majority and are not additional violations. Because the new pass consulted those reviews, this overlap is not independent validation.

paragraphs.en: Of the 14 candidate-computation units originally labeled not acted , 11 (78.6%) still reuse results across sections. Ten preserve the substantive restriction; V055 remains unresolved. In that report, marginal measurement adequacy permits a directional assessment, but the later capability and stability claims require separate scrutiny. The other three units lack a confirmed cross-section link. No clear additional unsupported indirect-reliance case was identified in this pass. paragraphs.en: DMAIC-Bench spans four industrial sectors but one methodological domain. To test whether the evaluation design transfers to workflows with different preconditions, we wrote two life-sciences cases against the unchanged task contract of § 3 : the same guarded decision graph, data steward, separate verifier and scoring axes. Only the domain layer changes: fourteen methods in four new families of the vocabulary, their reference implementations (numpy and scipy, as for the industrial methods), five public gate predicates, and task-specific nouns in the instruction (“study team” for “plant”). The cases are opt-in at discovery time and are built as their own dataset, so the 97-task corpus and every number in the main text are untouched by the pilot.
paragraphs.zh: DMAIC-Bench 覆盖四个工业领域，但同属一个方法论领域。 为了检验该评估设计能否迁移到具有不同前置条件的工作流，我们在 § 3 任务契约保持不变的前提下编写了两个生命科学案例：同样的受保护决策图、数据管理员、独立的验证器以及评分维度。 变化的只有领域层：词汇表中四个新族系的十四个方法、它们的参考实现（与工业方法一样采用 numpy 和 scipy）、五个公开的关卡谓词，以及指令中的任务特定名词（用「研究团队」替换「工厂」）。 这些案例在发现阶段是可选的，并被构建为独立的数据集，因此包含 97 个任务的语料库及正文中的所有数字均不受该试点的影响。

paragraphs.en: A targeted 400-gene panel compares compound-treated to vehicle-control cells, six libraries per arm, followed by an independent qPCR validation of the ten strongest calls and a gene-set over-representation of the validated list. The scenario reconstructs two published failures: the mouse ENCODE comparison in which sequencing batch was confounded with species ( Lin et al., 2014 ; Gilad & Mizrahi-Man, 2015 ) and the partially nested design of the ComBat-seq application, in which controls span three batches while each treatment sits in one (GEO series GSE83083 and GSE59765) ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) . The brief states four routing preconditions as the facility’s rules. A library is usable at ≥ 5 \geq 5 M assigned reads and ≥ 70 % \geq 70\% mapping, and each arm keeps at least three usable replicates. These floors are the brief’s settings, taken from the low end of published guidance: three biological replicates as the minimum for inferential analysis, five million mapped reads as enough for medium to highly expressed genes, and 70 to 90% as the expected mapping rate ( Conesa et al., 2016 ) ; the same literature recommends at least six replicates for whole-transcriptome designs ( Schurch et al., 2016 ) , so three is a floor for this panel. The treatment contrast must be estimable separately from batch among the usable libraries. This fails when every batch holds one arm, because batch and treatment are then confounded ( Leek et al., 2010 ) . With more than one batch, batch enters the model. A candidate list is issued only if the validation confirms three quarters of the nominated genes; the fraction is the brief’s rule, and the qPCR is reported to the MIQE standard ( Bustin et al., 2009 ) , which sets no such threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 一个靶向的400基因panel比较化合物处理细胞与溶媒对照细胞，每组六个文库，随后对最强十个结果进行独立qPCR验证，并对验证通过的基因列表做基因集过度代表分析。 该场景重构了两个已发表的失败案例：一个是小鼠ENCODE比较，其中测序批次与物种存在混淆（Lin等，2014；Gilad & Mizrahi-Man，2015），另一个是ComBat-seq应用中的部分嵌套设计，其中对照横跨三个批次而每个处理仅位于一个批次中（GEO系列GSE83083和GSE59765）（Zhang等，2020）。 该简报将四项路由前提条件作为设施规则加以陈述。 当_assigned reads≥5M且mapping率≥70%时文库可用，且每组保留至少三个可用重复。 这些下限是简报的设置，取自已发表指南的低端：三个生物学重复作为推断分析的最低要求，五百万mapped reads足以覆盖中高表达基因，70到90%作为预期mapping率（Conesa等，2016）；同一文献建议全转录组设计至少需要六个重复（Schurch等，2016），因此三个是该panel的下限。 在可用文库中，处理对比必须能够与批次分开估计。 当每个批次只包含一个组时，这一条件无法满足，因为此时批次与处理相混淆（Leek等，2010）。 当批次多于一个时，批次进入模型。 只有当验证确认了四分之三的被提名基因时才发布候选列表；该比例是简报的规则，且qPCR按MIQE标准（Bustin等，2009）报告，该标准并未设定此类阈值。

paragraphs.en: Eight seeds include two go routes (single batch, with and without an effect) and two divert routes (two batches mixed across arms). On the divert signal seed, the batch-blind comparison over-calls by at least ten genes. Two seeds give no-go routes: one arm per batch or four treated libraries below the read rules. On trap seed 6, the planned sheet is balanced and the replicate rule passes, but the four failed libraries leave one arm per batch among the usable ones. On trap seed 7, the panel calls forty genes convincingly and the qPCR confirms none, so the stop comes after four analyses. RNA-seq public predicates use only the agent’s declared values, as in the main corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 八个种子包括两条 go 路线（单批次，含与不含效应）和两条 divert 路线（两批次在组间混合）。 在 divert 信号种子上，不考虑批次的对比至少多报了十个基因。 两个种子给出 no-go 路线：每批次仅一臂，或四个处理后的文库低于读长规则。 在陷阱种子 6 上，计划表是均衡的且重复规则通过，但四个失败的文库使可用文库中每批次只剩一臂。 在陷阱种子 7 上，该 panel 有说服力地报出四十个基因，而 qPCR 一个也未确认，因此停止发生在四次分析之后。 RNA-seq 公共判定条件仅使用智能体声明的值，与主语料库相同。

paragraphs.en: A candidate-region panel tests 150 variants in 120 affected and 120 unaffected participants; 40 variants are ancestry-informative. An independent cohort of 60 affected and 60 unaffected participants provides replication on the same panel. The protocol follows the published QC tutorials ( Anderson et al., 2010 ; Marees et al., 2018 ) : participants with over 5% missing genotypes are dropped; variants are filtered on call rate, minor-allele frequency and Hardy–Weinberg in controls; the cohort is checked for ancestry structure on its leading axes before any variant is tested, and where structure is present but overlapping, the leading principal components enter as covariates ( Price et al., 2006 ) ; a discovery association is confirmed by replication ( NCI-NHGRI Working Group on Replication in Association Studies et al., 2007 ) . The plate rule is the case’s own: a plate with more than a tenth of its samples failed is re-genotyped. Eight seeds: two go routes, two divert routes (mixed ancestry; the unadjusted scan calls at least six variants, the adjusted scan one or none), two no-go routes (disjoint ancestry on PC1; a failed plate), and two traps: on seed 6 a balanced recruitment-site split dominates PC1, where status shows no difference ( p = 0.47 p=0.47 ), while the status-aligned ancestry split is disjoint on PC2; on seed 7 a genome-wide-significant discovery hit does not reproduce in replication. Every fork measures unenforced restraint, as in the four unlocked tasks of Appendix D : the discovery stages read one batch, and the replication batch remains unlocked.
paragraphs.zh: 一个候选区域面板在120名受累参与者和120名未受累参与者中检测150个变异；其中40个变异具有祖源信息价值。 一个由60名受累参与者和60名未受累参与者组成的独立队列在同一面板上提供重复验证。 该方案遵循已发表的质量控制教程（Anderson等，2010；Marees等，2018）：基因型缺失超过5%的参与者被剔除；变异按检出率、次要等位基因频率和对照组的哈迪–温伯格平衡进行过滤；在检验任何变异之前，先在主轴上检查队列的祖源结构，若存在结构但相互重叠，则将前几个主成分作为协变量纳入（Price等，2006）；发现阶段的关联须通过重复验证加以确认（NCI-NHGRI关联研究重复工作组等，2007）。 平板规则是该案例自有的：任何有超过十分之一样本失败了的平板都要重新分型。 八个种子：两个走「通过」路线，两个走「分流」路线（祖源混杂；未校正的扫描检出至少六个变异，校正后的扫描检出一个或零个），两个走「不通过」路线（PC1上祖源完全分离；一个失败平板），还有两个陷阱：种子6中，招募地点的均衡划分主导了PC1，而状态在PC1上无差异（p = 0.47），与状态对齐的祖源划分却在PC2上完全分离；种子7中，一个全基因组显著性水平的发现位点在重复验证中未能重现。 每个分岔点都衡量未被强制执行的克制，如附录D中四个未上锁的任务：发现阶段可读取一个批次，而重复验证批次保持未上锁状态。

sents.en: An independent cohort of 60 affected and 60 unaffected participants provides replication on the same panel.

sents.zh: 平板规则是该案例自有的：任何有超过十分之一样本失败了的平板都要重新分型。

paragraphs.en: Both cases pass the correspondence checks of Appendix C (C1–C7, no findings). The reference solution scores reward 1.000 1.000 with perfect routing and numerical fidelity on every built task it was run on, and the isolation probe finds no truth value in the agent image.
paragraphs.zh: 两种情况均通过了附录 C（C1–C7）的一致性检查，未发现问题。 参考解在其运行的所有已构建任务上均以完美的路由和数值保真度获得 1.000 1.000 的奖励，且隔离探针在智能体镜像中未发现真值。

paragraphs.en: GPT-6-astra, GPT-5.6-sol and GPT-5.6-luna each make three attempts per task using the same scaffold, plain instruction and gateway as in § 4.1 . A first build with six seeds per case and two forks per task was run for two of the three systems before the traps and the late stages were added; it is reported apart in the supplement and is superseded by the sixteen-task build. The brief the steward releases first exists in two forms. The protocol brief states each rule and what a failed rule forbids (a design in which every batch holds one arm supports no contrast; participants of separate ancestry cannot be compared), which is the regime of the normative instruction of § 4.5 . The thresholds-only brief states the same numbers and nothing about consequences, so the agent must determine whether a confounded design supports a contrast, as it is under the plain instruction in DMAIC; it is run once per task. Sixteen tasks, two graphs and three systems support per-fork counts, which Table 36 reports with their denominators; they are not population estimates.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-6-astra、GPT-5.6-sol 和 GPT-5.6-luna 每个任务各进行三次尝试，使用与 § 4.1 中相同的脚手架、简单指令和网关。 一个在陷阱和后期阶段加入之前运行的首次构建（每个案例六个种子、每个任务两个分叉）在三个系统中的两个上运行过；它在补充材料中单独报告，并被十六任务构建所取代。 管家首先发布的简报存在两种形式。 协议简报陈述每条规则以及违反规则所禁止的内容（每批次只含一个臂的设计不支持对比；不同血统的参与者无法进行比较），这属于 § 4.5 规范性指令的范畴。 仅阈值简报陈述相同的数字而不涉及任何后果，因此智能体必须自行判断一个存在混淆的设计是否支持对比，正如 DMAIC 中在简单指令下的情形；它每个任务运行一次。 十六个任务、两张图和三个系统支持按分叉统计的计数，表 36 报告了这些计数及其分母；它们不是总体估计。

paragraphs.en: (b) Matched first attempts: no-go decisions
paragraphs.zh: (b) 匹配的首次尝试：不执行决策

paragraphs.en: Table 36 reports counts and denominators. The reference solution solves all sixteen tasks at reward 1.000 1.000 . The steward enforces RNA-seq locks on declared values as in DMAIC, and the verifier grades every fork of every trial from the same three artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 表 36 报告了计数和分母。 参考解法在奖励 1.000 1.000 下解决了全部十六个任务。 管家按照 DMAIC 的方式对声明的值强制执行 RNA-seq 锁定，而验证器基于同样的三个工件对每次试验的每个分叉进行评分。

sents.en: Table 36 reports counts and denominators.
sents.zh: 表 36 报告了计数和分母。

sents.en: The reference solution solves all sixteen tasks at reward 1.000 1.000 .
sents.zh: 参考解法在奖励 1.000 1.000 下解决了全部十六个任务。

sents.en: The steward enforces RNA-seq locks on declared values as in DMAIC, and the verifier grades every fork of every trial from the same three artifacts.
sents.zh: 管家按照 DMAIC 的方式对声明的值强制执行 RNA-seq 锁定，而验证器基于同样的三个工件对每次试验的每个分叉进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Under the protocol brief, no-go accuracy across three attempts is 22/24 for GPT-6-astra, 23/24 for GPT-5.6-sol and 17/24 for GPT-5.6-luna, compared with three-attempt means of 24%, 22% and 25%, respectively, under the plain instruction on DMAIC (§ 4.2 ); go and divert accuracy are also higher. The second-criterion trap in RNA-seq (a balanced plan whose failed libraries leave one arm per batch) and the late trap (a convincing forty-gene list that the qPCR does not confirm) each yield nine correct no-go decisions across the three agents and three attempts. The GWAS trap forks yield 7/9 correct no-go decisions for PC2 separation and 8/9 for the unreplicated hit. Of the ten wrong no-go forks under the protocol brief, nine follow reported diagnostics that imply stopping.
paragraphs.zh: 在协议简报条件下，GPT-6-astra 三次尝试中的不通过（no-go）准确率为 22/24，GPT-5.6-sol 为 23/24，GPT-5.6-luna 为 17/24，而在 DMAIC 的普通指令（§ 4.2）下，三次尝试的平均值分别为 24%、22% 和 25%；通过（go）与转向（divert）的准确率也更高。 RNA-seq 中的第二判据陷阱（一个均衡的方案，其失败的文库使每个批次只剩一个分支）与后期陷阱（一份令人信服的四十个基因清单，但 qPCR 无法验证）在三个智能体和三次尝试中各产生九个正确的不通过决定。 GWAS 陷阱分支中，针对 PC2 分离产生 7/9 的正确不通过决定，针对未重复验证的显著位点产生 8/9 的正确不通过决定。 在协议简报条件下的十个错误不通过分支中，有九个遵循了所报告的、暗示应当停止的诊断结果。

sents.en: Under the protocol brief, no-go accuracy across three attempts is 22/24 for GPT-6-astra, 23/24 for GPT-5.6-sol and 17/24 for GPT-5.6-luna, compared with three-attempt means of 24%, 22% and 25%, respectively, under the plain instruction on DMAIC (§ 4.2 ); go and divert accuracy are also higher.
sents.zh: 在协议简报条件下，GPT-6-astra 三次尝试中的不通过（no-go）准确率为 22/24，GPT-5.6-sol 为 23/24，GPT-5.6-luna 为 17/24，而在 DMAIC 的普通指令（§ 4.2）下，三次尝试的平均值分别为 24%、22% 和 25%；通过（go）与转向（divert）的准确率也更高。

sents.en: The second-criterion trap in RNA-seq (a balanced plan whose failed libraries leave one arm per batch) and the late trap (a convincing forty-gene list that the qPCR does not confirm) each yield nine correct no-go decisions across the three agents and three attempts.
sents.zh: RNA-seq 中的第二判据陷阱（一个均衡的方案，其失败的文库使每个批次只剩一个分支）与后期陷阱（一份令人信服的四十个基因清单，但 qPCR 无法验证）在三个智能体和三次尝试中各产生九个正确的不通过决定。

sents.en: The GWAS trap forks yield 7/9 correct no-go decisions for PC2 separation and 8/9 for the unreplicated hit.
sents.zh: GWAS 陷阱分支中，针对 PC2 分离产生 7/9 的正确不通过决定，针对未重复验证的显著位点产生 8/9 的正确不通过决定。

sents.en: Of the ten wrong no-go forks under the protocol brief, nine follow reported diagnostics that imply stopping.
sents.zh: 在协议简报条件下的十个错误不通过分支中，有九个遵循了所报告的、暗示应当停止的诊断结果。

paragraphs.en: On first attempts across the three agents, removing the stated consequences (the thresholds-only brief) lowers no-go accuracy from 20/24 to 17/24. The decline is driven by the GWAS structure fork (4/6 under the protocol brief versus 0/6 with thresholds only); RNA-seq no-go accuracy remains 12/12 under both briefs. Across three protocol attempts, GPT-5.6-luna, the weakest agent here, fails almost only in the unlocked GWAS case (sample-QC stop 0/3, structure divert 0/6, structure stop 2/6) and is near-perfect in the locked RNA-seq case (no-go 12/12, divert 6/6), the pattern of the four unlocked DMAIC tasks in Appendix D . Two domains and three agents cannot isolate the effects of stated consequences, batch locks and fork position (§ 4.5 ), or establish population rates.
paragraphs.zh: 在三个智能体的首次尝试中，去除所陈述的后果（仅含阈值的简报）会使“禁止继续”的准确率从 20/24 降至 17/24。 这一下降由 GWAS 结构分叉引起（在协议简报下为 4/6，而仅含阈值时为 0/6）；两种简报下 RNA-seq 的“禁止继续”准确率均保持 12/12。 在三次协议尝试中，此处最弱的智能体 GPT-5.6-luna 几乎只在未锁定的 GWAS 情形中失败（样本 QC 停止 0/3，结构偏转 0/6，结构停止 2/6），而在锁定的 RNA-seq 情形中接近完美（禁止继续 12/12，偏转 6/6），这与附录 D 中四个未锁定 DMAIC 任务的模式一致。 两个领域和三个智能体无法分离所陈述的后果、批次锁定与分叉位置（§ 4.5）的影响，也无法确定总体比例。

paragraphs.en: a batch locked behind a declaration no method on its route could make (the lock reduced the reference-solution reward to 0.706 instead of the expected 1.000);
paragraphs.zh: 被其路线上的任何方法都无法做出的声明锁住的一批（该锁定将参考解奖励降至 0.706，而非预期的 1.000）；

paragraphs.en: a reference solution testing every process against a hypothesised mean of zero, which passed three control runs because no process sat near its target;
paragraphs.zh: 将每个过程的假设均值设定为零的参考解，在三次对照运行中通过了测试，因为没有过程接近其目标值；

paragraphs.en: a precondition check treated as evidence that the agent had taken the subsequent branch;
paragraphs.zh: 一个前置条件检查被当作智能体已采取后续分支的证据；

paragraphs.en: a capability-variant mismatch that treated a normal capability calculation as abstention when the node selected the nonnormal variant;
paragraphs.zh: 当节点选择了非正常变体时，将正常的_capability_计算视为弃权的一种能力变体不匹配问题；

paragraphs.en: a method id with its family name repeated (capability.capability_normal) interpreted as abstention on the tier that tests whether an agent stops; 18 of 1261 trials carried such ids, all now canonicalised to the method identifier expected by the scorer;
paragraphs.zh: 一个重复了其族名（family name）的方法 id（capability.capability_normal），在测试智能体是否停止的层级上被解释为弃权；1261 次试验中有 18 次包含此类 id，现在均已规范化为评分器（scorer）所期望的方法标识符；

paragraphs.en: (found by the second independent review) an own-number classifier that credited “the agent knew” when a guard field was unreported; a structural tier reader that counted an unrelated guarded edge as a divert, mislabelling two go seeds of case 38; and a case (case 31) whose narrative described another case’s characteristic while its data, limits and truths were its own; fixed in the source; every number in the paper comes from the corrected scorer;
paragraphs.zh: （由第二次独立审查发现）一个自身编号分类器，当守护字段未被报告时会判定为「智能体已知」；一个结构层级读取器，将一条不相关的受守护边计为分流，错误标记了案例 38 的两个 go 种子；以及一个案例（案例 31），其叙述描述的是另一个案例的特征，而其数据、限制与真值均属于其自身；已在源文件中修复；论文中的每个数字均来自修正后的评分器；

paragraphs.en: (found by the expert blind review) a fork judged on the trace-wide method set, allowing an analysis from an earlier stage to count as evidence of a later wrong turn (Appendix M ).
paragraphs.zh: （由专家盲审发现）基于整条轨迹的方法集合来判定的分叉，允许将较早阶段的分析算作较晚错误转向的证据（附录 M）。

paragraphs.en: The results describe the tested agents on 15 cases, not vendor rankings or a held-out evaluation. Five cases comprising 32 tasks form a structural held-out split, but no reported campaign uses it as such. Expert review covers sampled checkpoints, with study 1 informing corrections and study 2 frozen before assessment; it does not validate every trajectory (§ 3.3 ). Appendix O records nine scorer defects. The integrity gate equals 1.000 across 1261 first-attempt trials. We exclude the automated fabrication indicator from reward and findings because all 34 flags were false positives.

paragraphs.en: Route accuracy measures execution restraint; route errors and invalid report claims are distinct outcomes (Table 33 ), and the report-level rates come from a 60-unit audit of 11 agents; reweighting by agent leaves the estimate at 46% (Appendix M ), and the two agents outside the frame have the lowest route accuracy and are not covered. Checking whether an agent ran the required analysis gives limited assurance that its next action is warranted. Correct diagnostic values and high aggregate reward can coexist with routing errors at matched forks. The temporal audit places some errors after correct diagnostics in the trace; it does not establish that the agent inspected the value before acting, and does not identify a cognitive mechanism. Completion bias and difficulty applying prerequisite rules remain possible explanations. The plain brief adds a third: the case-33 instruction (Listing 3 ) asks whether the reject share has held steady and how the level compares with the requirement, quantities the reference route forbids once the gauge study fails, so some plain-condition continuation answers the brief rather than ignoring the evidence. The permit-stop and normative conditions remove that conflict, and DeepSeek still reaches only 44% NO-GO accuracy under the stated rule, so the conflict does not account for the whole gap. The intervention results motivate testing feedback that revises the plan, with paired success used to check that restraint preserves warranted continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 路径准确率衡量的是执行上的克制；路径错误与无效的报告声明是两种不同的结果（表 33），而报告层面的比率来自对 11 个智能体中 60 个单元的审计；按智能体重新加权后估计值仍为 46%（附录 M），处于该框架之外的两个智能体路径准确率最低且未被覆盖。 检查某个智能体是否执行了所需的分析，只能有限地保证其下一步行动是有依据的。 正确的诊断值和较高的总体奖励，可能与在相同分叉点上的路径错误并存。 时序审计将某些错误定位在轨迹中正确诊断之后；它并不能证明智能体在行动之前检视了该数值，也未识别出某种认知机制。 完成偏差以及难以应用前置规则仍是可能的解释。 简明简报增加了第三种解释：案例 33 的指令（清单 3）询问不合格占比是否保持稳定，以及该水平与要求相比如何，而这些量在量具研究失败后是参考路径所禁止的，因此一些简明条件下的继续作答是在回应简报而非忽视证据。 许可停止条件和规范性条件消除了这一冲突，而 DeepSeek 在所述规则下仍只达到 44% 的 NO-GO 准确率，因此该冲突无法解释全部差距。 干预结果促使我们测试能够修订计划的反馈，并使用成对成功来验证克制性会保留有依据的继续。

paragraphs.en: The cross-domain pilot covers two domains and three agents. Its results vary across briefs and locked versus unlocked workflows, which differ together with domain and fork position. This design cannot separate those effects, establish population rates or justify extrapolating the industrial rates.
paragraphs.zh: 跨领域试点覆盖两个领域和三个智能体。 其结果因任务说明以及锁定与未锁定工作流的不同而变化，后者还随领域和分叉位置共同变化。 该设计无法分离这些效应、确立总体比率，也无法证明将行业比率外推的合理性。
